10.	puḷḷi yiralait tōlū ṉutirttut
	tītukaḷain teñciya tikaḻviṭu pāṇṭiṟ
	paruti pōkiya puṭaikiḷai kaṭṭi
	eḵkuṭai yirumpi ṉuḷḷamaittu vallōṉ
	cūṭu nilaiyuṟṟuc cuṭarviṭu tōṟṟam
15.	vicumpāṭu marapiṟ paruntū ṟaḷappa
	nalampeṟu tirumaṇi kūṭṭu naṟṟōḷ
	oṭuṅkī rōti yoṇṇutal karuvil
	eṇṇiyaṉ muṟṟi yīraṟivu purintu
	cālpum cemmaiyu muḷappaṭap piṟavum
20.	kāvaṟ kamainta varacutuṟai pōkiya
	vīṟucāl putalvaṟ peṟṟaṉai yivaṇark
	karuṅkaṭa ṉiṟutta ceruppukaṉ muṉpa
	aṉṉavai maruṇṭaṉe ṉallē ṉiṉvayiṉ
	muḻutuṇarn toḻukku naraimū tāḷaṉai
25.	vaṇmaiyu māṇpum vaḷaṉu meccamum
	teyvamum yāvatun tavamuṭai yōrkkeṉa
	vēṟupaṭu naṉantalaip peyarak
	kūṟiṉai perumaniṉ paṭimai yāṉē.
tuṟai	:	centuṟaip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	nalampeṟu tirumaṇi
3-17. cāyaṟal .......... karuvil
urai :
cāy aṟal kaṭukkum - nuṇṇiya karumaṇalai yokkum; tāḻ iruṅ kūntal - tāḻnta kariya kūntalaiyum; koṭumaṇam paṭṭa viṉai māṇ aruṅkalam - koṭumaṇam eṉṉum ūrilē uṇṭākiya ariya kalaṉkaḷaiyum; pantar payanta palar pukaḻ muttam - pantar eṉṉum ūriṭattē peṟṟa palarum pukaḻkiṉṟa muttukkaḷaiyum; varai yakam naṇṇi - perumalai
kaḷai yaṭaintu avaṟṟiṭattum; kuṟumpoṟai nāṭi - ciṟu ciṟu malaikaḷai yaṭaintu avaṟṟiṭattum tēṭi; teriyunar koṇṭa -  kuṟṟamaṟa ārāyntukoḷḷum aṟiviṉai yuṭaiyōr koṇṭa; ciraṟuṭaip paimpoṟi - citaṟik kiṭattalaiyuṭaiya paciya poṟikaḷaiyum; kavaimaram kaṭukkum kavalaiya maruppiṉ - kavaikkōl pōlak kiḷaittalai
yuṭaiya kompiṉaiyum; puḷḷi iralaittōl - puḷḷiyiṉaiyu muṭaiya māṉtōlaik koṇṭu; ūṉ utirttu - ataṉ uṭpuṟattut tacaiyaik kaḷaintu; tītu kaḷaintu - ēṉai aḻukkukaḷaiyum pōkki; eñciya tikaḻ viṭu - eñci niṉṟa oḷi vīcukiṉṟa; pāṇṭiṟ paruti pōkiya puṭai - vaṭṭamāka aṟutta tōliṉ viḷimpilē; kiḷai kaṭṭi - iṉamākac cērak kaṭṭi; eḵkuṭai irumpiṉ - kūrmaiyaiyuṭaiya vūciyāl; vallōṉ - toḻil vallavaṉ; uḷḷamaittu - uṭpuṟattē maṇikaḷaip patittu aḻakuṟa aṇi ceytu; cūṭu nilaiyuṟṟu - cūṭutaṟkuriya nilaimaiyiṉai yuṟuvittu; cuṭar viṭu tōṟṟam - oḷi tikaḻkiṉṟa tōṟṟattaip peṟuvittalāl; vicum pāṭu marapiṉ - vicumpilē paṟakkum muṟaimaiyiṉai yuṭaiya; paruntu ūṟu aḷappa - paruntāṉatu ūṉeṉṟu karuti yataṉai yuṟṟuk kavartaṟku niṉaiyumāṟu; nalam peṟu tirumaṇi - nalam peṟṟa uyariya at tōṟpaṇiyākiya maṇiyai; kūṭṭum naṟṟōḷ - aṇikiṉṟa nalla tōḷiṉaiyum; oṭuṅkī rōti - oṭuṅkiya curuḷ eṉṉum pakutiyāṉa kūntalaiyum; oṇṇutal - oḷḷiya neṟṟiyiṉaiyum; vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉ - piṟappāl tirumakaḷiṉ vēṟupaṭṭā ḷeṉṉum ciṟappeytiya māṇpiṉaiyumuṭaiya niṉ tēviyiṉuṭaiya; niṉvaḻi vāḻiyar - niṉ kuṭivaḻi nīṭu vāḻvataṉ poruṭṭu; karuvil - karuviṭattē yamaintu eṉṟavāṟu.
meṉmaiyum nuṇmaiyu muṭaimaipaṟṟik karumaṇalai “cāyaṟal” eṉal vēṇṭiṟṟu. tāḻ iruṅ kūntal - mutukiṭattē tāḻnta kariya kūntal;  “puṟantāḻ piruḷiya piṟaṅkukura laimpāl” (akam : 126) eṉṟu piṟaruṅ kūṟutal kāṇka. kūntalaiyum, tōḷiṉaiyum nutaliṉaiyumuṭaiya tēviyiṉatu karuvil eṉak kūṭṭuka. tāḻiruṅ kūntaleṉṟavar maṟupaṭiyum oṭuṅkī rōti yeṉṟatu, kūntaliṉ nīṭciyum niṟappolivum potup paṭak kūṟi, ataṉaic curuḷ eṉṉum pakutiyāka muṭikkum ciṟappiṉai yuṇarttaṟku. tirumakaṭkuriya uruvum piṟa nalaṅ kaḷum poruntip piṟappoṉṟiṉāl vēṟupaṭuvatu kuṟittut tēviyai, “vēṟupaṭu tiru” eṉṟār. vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉ eṉpataṟkup paḻaiyavuraikārar, “vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉ eṉṟatu, ivaḷukkuk kūṟiya kuṇaṅkaḷāl avaḷiṉ vēṟākiya niṉ tēvi eṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “tiruviṉ eṉṉum iṉ acai nilai” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
koṭumaṇam, pantar eṉpaṉa, akkālattē ciṟappuṟṟirunta ūrkaḷ. viṉaimāṇ aruṅkalam, toḻilnalattāl māṇpuṟṟa aṇikalaṉkaḷ. palar, palanāṭṭavar.
vēḷviceytaṟkaṇ, ataṉaic ceyvōr nallilakkaṇam amainta puḷḷimāṉiṉ tōlait tūymaiceytu pōrttuk koḷpavātaliṉ, ataṉai, māṉilakkaṇam terintāraik koṇṭu peṟutal vēṇṭi viṭuttaliṉ, avarait “teriyunar” eṉṟum, avarkaḷ ataṉai nāṭip peṟumāṟu kūṟuvār. “varaiyakam naṇṇik kuṟumpoṟai nāṭit teriyunar” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. varaiyakam, perumalaittoṭar. kuṟum poṟai, ciṟu kuṉṟukaḷ niṟainta malaippakkam. kocci nāṭṭup pakutikaḷai iṭaikkālak kalveṭṭukkaḷ neṭum poṟai nāṭeṉṟum kuṟumpoṟai nāṭeṉṟum (A.R.No. 321 of 1924) kūṟukiṉṟaṉa. ivviṭattai naṇṇi nāṭutaliṉ, uyariya māṉ vakaikaḷ avviṭattē vāḻtal peṟṟām. nallilakkaṇam amainta māṉiṉnalam kūṟuvār, kiḷaitta kompuṭaimaiyum, uṭaleṅkum citaṟiya puḷḷiyuṭaimaiyum vitantu, “paim poṟik kavaimaram kaṭukkum kavalaiya maruppiṟ puḷḷiyiralai” yeṉṟār. “varaiyeṉṟatu perumalaiyai” yeṉṟum, kuṟum poṟai yeṉṟatu “ataṉai yaṇainta ciṟu poṟṟaikaḷai” yeṉṟum, “teriyunar kōṭal, ilakkaṇak kuṟṟamaṟa ārāyntu kōṭal” eṉṟum, “paimpoṟi yeṉṟatu cevvikaḷaiyuṭaiya puḷḷikaḷai” yeṉṟum, “mēṟ puḷḷiyiralai yeṉṟataṉai ataṉ cātippeyar kūṟiyavāṟākak koḷka” eṉṟum paḻaiyavurai kūṟum. ciraṟutal, citaṟutal. kavalai, kavarttal.
vēḷvi ceyvōṉ māṉ tōlaip pōrttukkoḷḷa, avaṉ maṉaivi attōlai vaṭṭamāka aṟuttu ataṉaic cuṟṟilum muttukkaḷaiyum piṟa vuyariya maṇikaḷaiyum kaṭṭi, naṭuvē uyariya māṇikkam maṇikaḷait taittut tōḷiṭattē aṇivaḷpōlum, īṇṭu āciriyar aracamātēvi ivvāṟu aṇintāḷeṉṟaliṉ. mayir mutaliyaṉa mūṭip poliviṉṟi yirukkum pakutiyait tītu eṉa vilakkutalāl, “tītu kaḷain teñciya tikaḻviṭu pāṇṭiṟ paruti” eṉṟum, vaṭṭamāṉa tōlaip “pāṇṭiṟ paruti” yeṉṟum, ataṉ viḷimpilē koṭumaṇattuk kalattaiyum pantariṭattup peṟṟa muttiṉaiyum iṉañcērak kaṭṭiṉāreṉṟaṟku, “puṭaikiḷai kaṭṭi” yeṉṟum, uḷḷiṭattē tāmarai mutaliya pūvaip pōlum aḻakiya vēlaippāṭṭiṉaic civanta māṇikka maṇi koṇṭu  toḻil vallunar, ceytataṉai “vallōṉ eḵkuṭai yirumpiṉ uḷḷamaittu” eṉṟum, avvāṟu amaittalāl cūṭutaṟkuriya nilaiyuṟuvatāl, “cūṭu nilaiyuṟṟu” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. uṟuvit teṉaṟpālatu, “uṟṟu” eṉa vantatu. civanta maṇikaḷ iṭaiyē patikkappeṟṟuc cevvoḷi kāṉṟu tikaḻtal kaṇṭu, ūṉeṉṟu karutip paruntu kavarntu cellak karutumeṉpār, “vicumpāṭu marapiṟ paruntū ṟaḷappa” eṉṟār. ūṉ tēṭi yuṟṟuṇṭu payiṉṟa kūriya pārvai yiṉaiyuṭaiya paruntiṉai mayakkumāṟu civanta oḷikoṇṭu viḷaṅkum maṇiyātalpaṟṟi, “nalam peṟu tirumaṇi” eṉap paṭṭatu. poṉṉiṭaip patittup poli vuṟuttap peṟum māṇikkamaṇi,  tōliṭaip patittavaḻiyum taṉ nalloḷi kuṉṟātu tikaḻum ciṟappuk kuṟittu ivvāṟu nalampeṟu tirumaṇi yeṉṟa nalattāl, ippāṭṭiṟku “nalampeṟu tirumaṇi”yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟṟeṉa vaṟika. iṉip paḻaiya vuraikārar, “nalampeṟu tirumaṇi yeṉṟatu maṇiyaṟivārāl ituvē nallateṉṟu collappaṭu talaiyuṭaiya tirumaṇi yeṉṟavāṟu; ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟku nalampeṟu tirumaṇi yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟṟu” eṉpar.
itaṉkaṭ kūṟiyavaṟṟait tokuttu nōkkiṉ, tāḻiruṅ kūntalaiyum, tirumaṇi kūṭṭum naṟṟōḷaiyum, ōtiyaiyum, oṇṇutalaiyum, vēṟupaṭu tiruviṉaiyumuṭaiya niṉ tēviyiṉ karuvilē eṉpatām. iṉi, ippakutikkaṇ vantavaṟṟiṟku uraikkuṟippuk kūṟuluṟṟa paḻaiyavuraikārar, “kavalaiya veṉṉum akaram ceyyuḷ vikāra” meṉṟum, pāṇṭi leṉṟatu, vaṭṭamāka aṟutta tōliṉai yeṉṟum, “paruti pōkiya puṭai yeṉṟatu, vaṭṭamākap pōṉa attōlatu viḷimpiṉai” yeṉṟum, “eḵkuṭai yirumpiṉ uḷḷamait teṉṟatu, kūrmaiyaiyuṭaiya karuvikaḷāl attōluṭ ceyyum toḻilkaḷellām ceytamait teṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, amaitteṉṟataṉai “amaippaveṉat tirikka” veṉṟum, vallōṉāl eṉa virittu “vallōṉāl niṉ tēvi cūṭutal nilaiyuṟutalāl eṉka” eṉṟum, “vallōṉ yākam paṇṇuvikka vallavaṉ” eṉṟum, “tōṟṟa meṉṟatu, tōṟṟamuṭaiya attōliṉai” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar. karuvil eṉpataṉōṭu amainteṉa oru col varuvittu, vāḻiya reṉṟa muṟṟeccattukku muṭipākkātu, “vāḻiyareṉṉum viṉaiyeccattiṉaic cūṭu nilaiyuṟṟu eṉṉum viṉaiyoṭu muṭikka” eṉpar paḻaiyavuraikārar.
18-21. eṇṇiyal ......... peṟṟaṉai
urai :
eṇ iyal muṟṟi - eṇṇappaṭukiṉṟa tiṅkaḷ pattum nirampi; īr aṟivu purintu - iruvakai yaṟivum amaintu; cālpum cemmaiyum uḷappaṭap piṟavum - cālpum naṭuvu nilaiyu muḷḷiṭṭa piṟa naṟpaṇpukaḷum; kāvaṟ kamainta aracu tuṟai pōkiya vīṟu cāl - nāṭu kāttaṟku vēṇṭum araciya laṟivu vakai palavum muṟṟak kaṟṟuttuṟaipōkiya ciṟappum niṟainta; putalvaṟ peṟṟaṉai ivaṇarkku - naṉmakaṉaip peṟṟuḷḷāy in nilavulakattu vāḻvārporuṭṭu eṉṟavāṟu.
karuvaḷartaṟkuriya kālattai ovvoru tiṅkaḷāka veṇṇupavātaliṉ. “eṇṇiyal muṟṟi” yeṉṟār. īraṟivu - iruvakai yaṟivu: avai iyaṟkaiyum ceyaṟkaiyumākiya iru vakai yaṟivukaḷ. iyaṟkaiyāya kaṇṇoḷi yillārkku ēṉai ñāyiṟṟoḷi mutaliyaṉa payaṉpaṭāmaipōla. iyaṟkaiyāya uṇmaiyaṟivillārk kalvi kēḷvikaḷāṉām ceyaṟkaiyaṟivu payaṉpaṭātākaliṉ, “īraṟivu purintu” eṉṟāreṉṟumām. immai maṟumai yaṟivukaḷumām. periya aṟiveṉiṉumamaiyu meṉpar paḻaiyavuraikārar. cālpu, naṟkuṇaṅkaḷiṉ niṟaivu; aṉpu, nāṇ, oppuravu, kaṇṇōṭṭam, vāymai eṉṟa aintiṉ niṟaivu. aracāḷum tiṟaṉum karuvilē vāykkun tiruveṉṟaṟku, “kāvaṟkamainta aracu tuṟai pōkiya vīṟu” eṉṟār. piṟanta piṉpē ivai yāvum peṟaṟ kuriyavāyiṉum, ivaṟṟiṉ pēṟu iṉitu poruntutaṟkuriya nalvāyppuk karuvilē uṇṭāva tākaliṉ, ivvāṟu kūṟiṉār eṉa aṟika. ikkaruttē, “peṟumavaṟṟuḷ yāmaṟiva tillai aṟivaṟinta, makkaṭpē ṟalla piṟa” (kuṟaḷ. 61) eṉpuḻiyum amaintukiṭattal kāṇka. peṟṟaṉai yeṉpataip paḻaiyavurai kārar muṟṟeccamākki mēl varuvaṉavaṟṟōṭu muṭippar. aracaṉatu putalvaṟpēṟu avaṉ kōṟkīḻ vāḻvārkku ēmamātal paṟṟi, “ivaṇark” keṉṟār. makkaṭpēṟu, peṟṟōrkkē yaṉṟi ip perunilattu vāḻvārkku nalam payakkum iyalpiṟ ṟeṉpatu paṇṭait tamiḻ naṉmakkaḷ koḷkai. “tammiṉtam makkaḷ aṟivuṭaimai mānilattu, maṉṉuyirk kellām iṉitu” (kuṟaḷ. 68) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka.
1-2. kēḷvi ......... uvappa
urai:
kēḷvi kēṭṭu - arumaṟaip poruḷai aṟivar uraippak kēṭṭu; paṭivam oṭiyātu - avar uraitta virataṅkaḷai mēṟkoṇṭu tavirātoḻuki; uyarntōr uvappa - aṟivu oḻukkaṅkaḷāl uyarnta naṉmakkaḷ maṉamakiḻumpaṭi; vēḷvi vēṭṭaṉai - vēḷvikaḷaic ceytu muṭittāy eṉṟavāṟu.
arumaṟaipporuḷai oruvar tāmē kaṟṟuṇartal kūṭāmaiyiṉ, “kēḷvi kēṭṭu” eṉṟār. kēḷvi, arumaṟaip poruḷ; kēṭṭaṟ kuriyatu atuvākaliṉ, kēṭṭa poruḷai naṭaimuṟaiyil teḷintu nallaṟivu kaivarap peṟutaṟku virata voḻukkam vēṇṭiyiruttalāl, “paṭiva moṭiyātu” eṉṟār. kēṭṭavaṟṟai maṉattāl oṉṟiyiruntuṇartaṟkut tuṇaiceyvatu paṭivameṉa vuṇarka. vēḷvippayaṉ uyarnilai yoḻukkattuc cāṉṟōrkku uvakai payappippatātalāl, “uyarntō ruvappa vēḷvi vēṭṭaṉai” yeṉṟār “āṉṟa kēḷvi yaṭaṅkiya koḷkai, nāṉmaṟai mutalvar cuṟṟamāka, maṉṉa rēval ceyya maṉṉiya, vēḷvi muṟṟiya vāyvāḷ vēntē” (puṟam. 26) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka.
iṉi, paḻaiyavuraikārar, “kēḷvi kēṭṭal - yākam paṇṇu taṟkuṭalāṉa viti kēṭṭal; paṭivam - yākam paṇṇu taṟku uṭalāka muṉpu celuttum virataṅkaḷ. “oṭiyāteṉpatai oṭiyāmal eṉat tirikka” eṉṟum, “vēṭṭaṉai eṉṟataṉai viṉaiyeccamuṟṟākki avviṉaiyeccattiṉai aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta eṉṉum viṉaiyoṭu kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum, “uyarntōr tēva” reṉṟum kūṟuvar.
22-28. aruṅkaṭaṉ .......... paṭimaiyāṉē
urai :
aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta - in nilavulakattu vāḻvārkku aracarāyiṉār ceytaṟkuriya ariya kaṭaṉkaḷaic ceytu muṭitta; ceruppukal muṉpa - pōrai virumpum valiyiṉaiyuṭai yōy; niṉvayiṉ aṉṉavai maruṇṭaṉeṉ allēṉ - niṉpāl kēḷviyum vēḷviyum putalvaṟpēṟumākiya avai yiṟṟaik kaṇṭu viyappuṟṟē ṉallēṉ; muḻutuṇarn toḻukkum naraimūtāḷaṉai - uṇarat takuvaṉavaṟṟai muḻutum uṇarntu piṟarkkum uṇartti naṉṉeṟi yoḻukappaṇṇum naraiyum mutumaiyumuṭaiya purōkitaṉai; niṉ paṭimaiyāṉ - nī mēṟ koṇṭirukkum tava voḻukkattāl; vaṇmaiyum  māṇpum vaḷaṉum eccamum teyvamum yāvatum tavam uṭaiyōrkku eṉa - koṭaiyum kuṇavamaitiyum celvamum makappēṟum teyvavuṇarvum piṟavum muṉṉait tavamuṭaiyārkkē yuḷavāvaṉa eṉa aṟivuṟutti; vēṟupaṭu naṉantalai peyarak kūṟiṉai - nāṭṭiṉ vēṟupaṭṭa akaṉṟa iṭamākiya kāṭṭiṟkut tavaṅ kuṟittuc cellap paṇittaṉai; peruma - perumāṉē! itu kaṇṭaṉṟē yāṉmaruṭkai yeytuvē ṉāyiṉēṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta muṉpa, ceruppukal muṉpa eṉa iyaiyum. makappēṟṟāl ivaṇaraiyum, vēḷvi vēṭṭalāl uyarntōraiyum ōmputalpaṟṟi “aruṅkaṭaṉ iṟutta” eṉṟum, cerumēmpaṭṭārkkaṉṟi ivvaruṅkaṭaṉ eḷitil iṟuk kalākāmai tōṉṟa, “ceruppukal muṉpa” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. uyar poruḷai yōti yuṇarntum piṟark kuraittum tāṉoḻuka vallavaṉ eṉṟaṟkup purōkitaṉai “muḻutuṇarn toḻukkum naraimū tāḷaṉai” eṉṟār. naraippum mutumaiyu maṉṟi, vaṇmaiyum māṇpu mutalāyiṉa avaṉpāl peruka uḷavātal vēṇṭic cēramāṉ irakkaṅkoṇṭu avaṟṟaip peṟumāṟu aṟivukkoṭai vaḻaṅkiṉāṉ eṉpār, “vaṇmaiyum māṇpum vaḷaṉum eccamum teyvamum yāvatum tavamuṭai yōrkku eṉa” aṟivuṟuttiṉāṉ eṉṟār. eccam pukaḻkkurit tāyiṉum, vaṇmaiyum māṇpum kūṟavē ap pukaḻum avaṟṟiṉ pāl aṭaṅkutalāl makkaṭ pēṟāyiṟṟu. iṉip paḻaiyavurai kārar, “naraimūtāḷaṉai yeṉṟatu, purōkitaṉai” yeṉṟum, “narai mūtāḷaṉaik kūṟiṉai yeṉak kūṭṭi avaṉaic colli yēviṉaiyeṉa orucol varuvittu muṭikka” eṉṟum, “māṇ peṉṟatu māṭcimaiyuṭaiya kuṇaṅkaḷai” yeṉṟum, “ecca meṉṟatu piḷḷaippēṟṟiṉai” yeṉṟum, “teyvameṉṟatu tammāl vaḻipaṭum teyvattiṉai” eṉṟum “tavamuṭaiyōrk keṉac colli yeṉka” eṉṟum, “kūṟiṉai yeṉpatu viṉai yeccamuṟ” ṟeṉṟum, “vēṟupaṭu naṉantalai yeṉṟatu tuṟantu pōyirukkum kāṭṭiṉai” yeṉṟum, “peyara veṉṟatu an naraimūtāḷaṉaik kāṭṭilē peyara vēṇṭi” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar. 
purōkitaṉ ceṉṟa kāṭṭiṉai, “vēṟupaṭu naṉantalai” yeṉṟār, aimpoṟikaḷāṉum āra nukarum nukarccikkiṭaṉākum nāṭṭiṉum, avaṟṟai yaṭakkutaṟkut tuṇaiyākum ciṟappup paṟṟi vēṟupaṭutaliṉ. cēramāṉ, ivvāṟu taṉ paṭimaiyāṉ purōkitaṉait tuṟavumēṟkoḷḷap paṇittamai nōkkiṉ, appurōkitaṉ āṉṟavintaṭaṅkum cālpiṟ kuṟaipaṭṭamaiyum, ataṉai niṟaittukkōṭaṟku vēntaṉ kaṇṇōṭi vēṟupaṭu naṉantalaip peyarttamaiyum peṟṟām. itu kaṇṭaṉṟē yeṉpatu mutalāyiṉa kuṟippeccam.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: ceruppukal muṉpa, peruma, tāḻiruṅ kūntalaiyum, naṟṟōḷaiyum, ōtiyaiyum, nutalaiyum tiru viṉaiyumuṭaiya niṉ tēviyiṉ karuvilē, iyal muṟṟi, aṟivu purintu, aracu tuṟai pōkiya putalvaṟ peṟṟaṉai ivaṇar poruṭṭu; uyarntōruvappa vēḷvi vēṭṭaṉai; aṉṉavai kaṇṭu maruṇṭaṉeṉallēṉ; narai mūtāḷaṉai, niṉpaṭimai yāṉ, vēṟupaṭu naṉantalaip peyarak kūṟiṉai; itu kaṇṭaṉṟē maruṭkai yeytuvēṉāyiṉēṉ eṉpatām. iṉip paḻaiya vurai, “vēṭṭaṉai yeṉṟum, peṟṟaṉaiyeṉṟum nī ceyta yākaṅkaḷākiya aṉṉavaiyiṟṟiṟku yāṉ maruṇṭēṉallēṉ, niṉṉai nalvaḻi yoḻukuvittu niṉṟa narai mūtāḷaṉai niṉpaṭimaiyāṉē illaṟa voḻukkiṉai yoḻittut tuṟavaṟa voḻukkilē cella oḻukuvittaṉai; avvāṟu ceyvitta niṉ pēroḻukkattaiyum pēraṟiviṉaiyum terintu yāṉ maruṇṭēṉeṉa viṉai muṭivu ceyka” eṉṟu kūṟum.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ nalloḻukkamum ataṟkēṟṟa nallaṟivuṭaimaiyum kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.”
5. tīñcēṟṟi yāṇar
1.	irumpuli koṉṟu peruṅkaḷi ṟaṭūum
	arumpoṟi vayamā ṉaṉaiyai palvēṟ
	polantār yāṉai yiyaṟērp poṟaiya
	vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum kīḻppaṇintu
5.	niṉvaḻip paṭāa rāyi ṉeṉmik(ku)
	aṟaiyuṟu karumpiṉ tīñcēṟṟi yāṇar
	varunar varaiyā vaḷamvīṅ kirukkai
	vaṉpulan taḻīiya meṉpā ṟōṟum
	marupula viṉaiñar pulavikal paṭuttuk 1
10.	kaḷḷuṭai niyamat toḷvilai koṭukkum
	veḷvara kuḻuta koḷḷuṭaik karampaic
	cennel valci yaṟiyār tattam
	pāṭal cāṉṟa vaippiṉ
	nāṭuṭa ṉāṭal yāvaṇa tavarkkē.
tuṟai	:	centuṟaip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	tīñcēṟṟiyāṇar
1-3. irumpuli .............. poṟaiya
urai :
pal vēl polantār yāṉai iyal tērp poṟaiya - palavākiya vēṟpaṭaiyum poṉṉarimālai yaṇinta yāṉaiyum iyalukiṉṟa tērumuṭaiya peruñcēralirum poṟaiyē; irumpuli koṉṟu - periya puliyaik koṉṟu; peruṅ kaḷiṟu aṭūum - ataṉālum cōrvaṭaiyātu uṭaṉ ceṉṟu periya yāṉaiyaik kollukiṉṟa; arum poṟi vayamāṉ aṉaiyai - ariya varikaḷaiyum valiyaiyumuṭaiya arimāviṉai oppāy; eṉṟavāṟu.
peruṅkaḷiṟṟiṉum irumpuli vali mikavuṭaittātaliṉ, ataṉaik koṉṟum cōrvaṭaiyātē iṭaiyaṟaviṉṟip peruṅkaḷiṟṟiṉaiyum kollum peruvaliyuṭaimai tōṉṟa “irumpuli koṉṟu peruṅkaḷiṟu aṭūum” eṉṟār. arimāviṟkup poṟaiyaṉaiyum, pulikku ēṉai vēntaraiyum peruṅkaḷiṟṟukku vēḷir mutalāyiṉāraiyum koḷka. polantār, poṉṉarimālai.
4-7. vēntarum .......... vīṅkirukkai
urai :
vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum kīḻppaṇintu niṉ vaḻip paṭāa rāyiṉ - muṭivēntarum kuṟunilamaṉṉarum piṟarum niṉṉaik kīḻppaṇintu niṉ viruppiṉvaḻi oḻukārāyiṉ; nel mikku - nel mikku viḷaiya; aṟaiyuṟu karumpiṉ tīñcēṟṟu yāṇar - ataṟkiṭaiyūṟāka vaḷarntu muṟṟiyiruttal paṟṟi veṭṭappaṭṭa karumpiṉatu tīviya cāṟākiya putu varuvāyiṉai; varunar varaiyā vaḷam vīṅku irukkai - avviṭattē varuvōrkku varaiyātu vaḻaṅkum celvam mikunta irukkaikaḷ (ūrkaḷ) eṉṟavāṟu.
nelmikku viḷaitalāl ataṉaiyum, karumpiṉ tīñ cāṟu mēṉ mēlum perukutalāl ataṉaiyum varuvōrkku varaiyātu vaḻaṅkupa eṉpatām. aṟaiyuṟu karumpu. aṟuttalaip poruntiya karumpu. iṟuttal iṟaiyeṉa varutalpōla, aṟuttal aṟaiyeṉa vantatu. nellukku vēliyāka naṭṭa karumpu mika vaḷarntu nelliṉ vaḷarcciyaik keṭuttalāl, aṟukkappaṭṭa karumpu eṉṟaṟku “aṟaiyuṟu karumpu” eṉṟā reṉka. paḻaiya vurai kārarum, “nelmikku aṟaiyuṟu karum peṉṟatu, nelliṉ kaṇṇē annellai nerukki mika eḻuntamaiyāṉē aṟukka luṟṟa karumpeṉṟavāṟu” eṉṟum, “iṉi, anneṟṟāṉ karumpiṉ mika eḻuntu ataṉai nerukkiṉamaiyal annelliṟku iṭa muṇṭāka aṟutta karumpu eṉiṉumām” eṉṟum uraippar. varaiyātu vaḻaṅkiya vaḻiyum vaḷam kuṉṟāmaipaṟṟi, “varaiyā vaḷam vīṅkirukkai” eṉṟār. mikku eṉpatai mika veṉat tirikka.
“tīñcēṟu iṉiya pāku” eṉṟum, “yāṇareṉṟatu, at tīñcēṟṟatu iṭaiyaṟa viṉmaiyai” eṉṟum, “ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟkut tīñcēṟṟiyāṇar eṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum paḻaiyavuraikārar kūṟuvar.
nellukku vēliyāka naṭṭa karumpu mika vaḷarntu ataṉ vaḷarccikku iṭaiyūṟāvatu kaṇṭu ataṉait taṭintupeṟṟa tīñcēṟṟiyāṇarai varunarkku varaiyātu vaḻaṅkuvareṉṟatu, kuṭi puṟantārātu avarkku iṭaiyūṟu viḷaikkum koṭuṅ kōlaracai veṉṟu, avarpāṟ peṟṟa poruḷai varunarkku varaiyātu vaḻaṅkum cēramāṉatu naṟceyal uḷḷuṟut turaittavāṟu.
8-14. vaṉpulam ................ tavarkkē
urai :
vaṉpulam taḻīiya meṉpāl tōṟum - vaṉṉilaṅkaḷaic cāravuḷḷa maruta nilaṅkaḷtōṟum; marupula viṉaiñar - vittiyatu muḷaiyāta kaḷarnilattē toḻiliṉaic ceyyum maṟavar; pulavikal paṭuttu - am marutavayalkaḷaik kōṭal kuṟittu nikaḻttum māṟupāṭṭaik keṭuttaḻittu; kaḷḷuṭai niyamattu oḷvilai koṭukkum - avarpāṟ peṟṟuk kaḷviṟkum kaṭaikaḷil kaḷḷiṟku vilaiyākak koṭukkum; veḷvaraku uḻuta koḷḷuṭaik karampai - uḻutu vittiya veḷḷai varakum koḷḷum viḷaiyum karampaiyāy viṭutalāl; cennel valci aṟiyār - avvarakum koḷḷu mallatu cenneṟcōṟu peṟātu varuntupa vākaliṉ, avarkku - av vēntar mutalāyiṉārkku; tattam pāṭal cāṉṟa vaippiṉ nāṭu - tattammuṭaiya pulavar pāṭum pukaḻ amainta ūrkaḷai yuṭaiya nāṭṭai; uṭaṉ āṭal yāvaṇatu - oruṅku āḷuvatu eṅṅaṉam kūṭum eṉṟavāṟu.
eḷitil uḻutu vittutaṟkākāta vaṉṉilattaic cārntuḷḷa maruta vayalkaḷai, “vaṉpulan taḻīiya meṉpāl” eṉṟār. meṉpālil nalla viḷaivu uṇṭātaliṉ, ataṉaik kōṭaṟku ēṉai vaṉpulattu vāḻum marunilattār virumpi muyalpa vātalālum, akkālai meṉpulattu vāḻnar avaroṭu porupa vātalālum, appōril tōṟkum marupula viṉaiñar tampāl uḷḷa varakum koḷḷum taṇṭamākat tarupavāta lālum, “marupula viṉaiñar pulavikal paṭuttu” eṉṟum, at taṇṭapporuḷum kaḷvilaikkē payaṉpaṭukiṟateṉpār, “kaḷḷuṭai niyamattu oḷvilai koṭukkum veḷvara kuḻutakoḷ” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. marupulam, kaḷarnilam. “marunila muḻutatil eru mikap peytu, vittiṭṭāṅkē koḷḷac, cittat tuṉṉum mattar pōlavum” (tirukkaḻumala mummaṇi. 22 : 16-8) eṉap paṭṭiṉattaṭikaḷ kūṟuvatu kāṇka. vaṉpulan taḻīiya meṉpā leṉṟaliṉ, vaṉpulattār meṉ pulattiṉkaṇ vaḻakkut toṭuppa rātalāl, ataṉaip “pulavikal” eṉṟār. meṉpula viṉaiñarāl pulliyavākak karutappaṭum varakum koḷḷum vaṉpulattārkku oṇ poruḷātalāl, kaḷḷiṟku avaṟṟai uyariya poruḷākak koṭuppa reṉpār, “oḷvilai koṭukkum” eṉṟār. av vaḷam vīṅku irukkaikaḷ veḷvarakum koḷḷum vittum karampaiyāy viṭutalāl, “veḷvara kuḻuta koḷḷuṭaik karampai” yeṉṟār. karampai yeṉpuḻi ātaliṉ eṉa oru col varuvikka. vaḷam vīṅkirukkai, karampaiyātaliṉ eṉa iyaiyum. naṉṉilaṅkaḷai yaḻittuk kaḻutaiyērpūṭṭi veḷvarakum koḷḷum vittutal paṇṭaiyōr muṟai; “iruṅkaḷantōṟum, veḷvāyk kaḻutaip pulliṉam pūṭṭi, veḷḷai varakum koḷḷum vittum, vaika luḻava” (puṟam. 392) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. ivvāṟu tām irukkum irukkaikaḷ karampaiyāy viṭutalāl vēntar mutalāyiṉār cennel luṇaviṉṟi vaṟumaiyuṟṟu valikuṉṟiṉa reṉpār, “cennel valci yaṟiyār” eṉṟum, eṉavē, avartam nāṭṭai iṉitāḷutal illai yeṉṟaṟku, “nāṭuṭa ṉāṭal yāvaṇa tavarkkē” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. “pāṭal cāṉṟa vaippiṉ nāṭu” eṉṟatu, nāṭṭiṉ naṉmai kūṟi yiraṅkiyatu.
itukāṟuṅ kūṟiyatu: poṟaiya, nī arumpoṟi vayamāṉ aṉaiyai; vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum kīḻppaṇintu niṉ vaḻippaṭārāyiṉ, avaruṭaiya vaḷam vīṅkirukkai, karampai yātaliṉ, cennel valci yaṟiyārāyt tattam nāṭuṭaṉāṭal avarkku yāvaṇatām eṉpatām. iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, vaṉpulantaḻīi yeṉṟu pāṭaṅ koṇṭu, ataṉaik karampai yoṭu kūṭṭi, iruntu eṉa oru col varuvittu vaṉpulam taḻīi yiruntu eṉṟum, meṉpāltōṟum iruntu eṉṟum iyaittu, “poṟaiya, nī puli koṉṟu kaḷiṟaṭūum vayamāṉ aṉaiyai; ataṉāl vēntarum vēḷirum piṟarum niṉṉaṭik kīḻp paṇintu, tamakkuriya meṉpālkaṭōṟum iruntu muṉ paṇinta vāṟṟiṟ kēṟpa niṉvaḻi yoḻukārāyiṉ, avarkaḷ veḷḷavarakuḻuta koḷḷuṭaik karampaiyākiya vaṉpālilē keṭṭuppō yiruntu āṇṭu viḷainta veḷvaraku uṇpataṉṟit tām paṇṭuṇṇum cennel valci uṇṇak kiṭaiyātapaṭi miṭipaṭukiṉṟār; tattam nāṭṭiṉai oruṅku āḷutal avarkku yāvaṇatu eṉa viṉaimuṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ veṉṟicciṟappuk kūṟiya vāṟāyiṟṟu.”
6. mācita ṟirukkai
1.	kaḷiṟuṭaip peruñcaman tataiya veḵkuyart
	toḷiṟuvāṇ maṉṉar tutainilai koṉṟu
	muracukaṭip paṭaiya varuntuṟaip pōkip
	peruṅkaṭa ṉīntiya maramvali yuṟukkum
5.	paṇṇiya vilaiñar pōlap puṇṇorīip
	peruṅkait toḻutiyiṉ vaṉṟuyar kaḻippi
	irantōr vāḻa nalki yirappōrk
	kīta ṟaṇṭā mācita ṟirukkai
	kaṇṭaṉeṉ celku vantaṉeṉ kālkoṇṭu
10.	karuvi vāṉan taṇṭaḷi corinteṉap
	palvitai yuḻaviṟ cillē rāḷar
	paṉittuṟaip pakaṉṟaip pāṅkuṭait teriyal
	kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkaṅ kaṭuppac cūṭi
	ilaṅkukatirt tirumaṇi peṟūum
15.	akaṉkaṇ vaippi ṉāṭukiḻa vōyē.
tuṟai	:	centuṟaip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	mā cita ṟirukkai
9-15. kāl koṇṭu ......... nāṭukiḻa vōyē
urai:
karuvi vāṉam kāl koṇṭu taṇtaḷi corinteṉa - tokuti koṇṭa maḻaimēkam nāṟṟicaiyum kāliṟaṅkit taṇṇiya maḻaiyaip peytatāka; palvitai uḻaviṉ cil ērāḷar - mikutiyāka vitaittaṟkēṟpap paranta uḻunilaṅkaḷai yuṭaiya cilavākiya ērkaḷaiyuṭaiya uḻavar; paṉittuṟaip pakaṉṟaip pāṅkuṭait teriyal - kuḷirnta nīrttuṟai yiṭattē malarntuḷḷa pakaṉṟaip pūvāṟṟoṭutta aḻakuṭaiya mālaiyai; kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam kaṭuppac cūṭi - veḷukkappaṭṭa veḷḷāṭaipōlat talaiyiṟcūṭikkoṇṭu; ilaṅku katirt tirumaṇi peṟūum - uḻum paṭaiccāliṭattē viḷaṅku kiṉṟa katirkaḷaiyuṭaiya aḻakiya maṇikaḷaip peṟukiṉṟa; akaṉkaṇ vaippiṉ nāṭu kiḻavōy - akaṉṟa iṭamuṭaiya ūrkaḷ poruntiya nāṭṭukku uriyōṉē eṉṟavāṟu.
iṭi miṉṉal, maḻai mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ tokutiyātal paṟṟi, “karuvi vāṉam” eṉappaṭṭatu. maḻaimukil nāṟṟicaiyum paravumiṭattuk kālviṭ ṭiṟaṅkutal kaṇkūṭātaliṉ “kāl koṇṭu” eṉṟār. kālkoṇṭeṉpataṟkup pey talait toṭaṅki yeṉṟalumām. vitaiyiṉ perumaiyai nōkka, uḻutaṟkuriya ērkaḷ ciṟiyavātal paṟṟi, “palvitai yuḻaviṟ cillē rāḷar” eṉṟār. “akala vuḻuvatiṉum āḻa vuḻutal vēṇṭumātalāl ataṟkēṟṟa perumaiyuṭaiya vākātu ciṟumaiyuṭaimaipaṟṟiyē “cillērāḷar” eṉṟu kūṟal vēṇṭiṟṟu. ciṉmai, ciṟumai kuṟittu niṉṟatu. paḻaiya vuraikārarum, “ciṉmaiyaic ciṉṉū leṉṟatupōla īṇṭuc ciṟumaiyākak koḷka” eṉṟār. cillērāḷar uḻuta paṭaiccāl mika āḻamuṭaittaṉ ṟāyiṉum, ataṉkaṇṇum avarkaḷ mikka viḷai payaṉē yaṉṟi uyariya maṇikaḷaip peṟukiṉṟārka ḷeṉpār; “cillē rāḷar ilaṅkukatirt tirumaṇi peṟūum nāṭu” eṉṟār.
pakaṉṟai malarkku veḷutta āṭaiyai uvamai kūṟutalum, āṭaikku ammalarai yuvamai kūṟutalum cāṉṟōr vaḻakkākum. “pōtuviri pakaṉṟaip putumala raṉṉa, akaṉṟumaṭi kaliṅka muṭīic celvamum, kēṭiṉṟu nalkumati peruma” (puṟam. 393) eṉṟu nalliṟaiyaṉār eṉṉum cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. pakaṉṟaiyaik kaṇṇiyākat toṭuttaṇitalē perum pāṉmai vaḻakkātaliṉ, teriyaleṉṟatu kaṇṇiyeṉak koḷḷap paṭṭatu; “pakaṉṟaikkaṇṇip pallāṉ kōvalar” (aiṅ. 87) eṉṟum, “pakaṉṟaik kaṇṇip paḻaiyar” (malaipaṭu. 459) eṉṟum varutal kāṇka. calavai ceyyappaṭṭa āṭai yeṉṟaṟkuk “kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam” eṉṟār. uyarnta maṇiyeṉpār, “tirumaṇi” yeṉṟār. peru varuvāyuṭaimai tōṉṟa, akaṉkaṇ vaippiṉ nāṭu eṉṟu ciṟappikkappaṭṭatu.
iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, “taṇṭaḷi corinteṉa ērāḷar katirt tirumaṇi peṟūum nāṭu eṉak kūṭṭi, maḻai peytalāṉē ērāḷar uḻutu viḷaittukkōṭalē yaṉṟi uḻuta iṭaṅkaḷ tōṟum oḷiyaiyuṭaiya tirumaṇikaḷai yeṭuttukkoḷḷum nāṭeṉa vuraikka” eṉṟum, “palvitai yuḻaviṉ cillē rāḷareṉṟatu, palavitai yuḻavāṟ periyā rāyiṉum tam kulattāṉum oḻukkattāṉum ciṟiya ērāḷa reṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “pakaṉṟait teriyal kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam kaṭuppac cūṭit tirumaṇi peṟūum eṉak kūṭṭi, pakaṉṟai mālaiyaik kaḻuvuṟu kaliṅkam oppac cūṭikkoṇṭu niṉṟu tirumaṇikaḷai yeṭukkumeṉa vuraikka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
1-9. kaḷiṟuṭaip peruñcamam ........ vantaṉeṉ
urai:
kaḷiṟu uṭaip peruñcamam tataiya - kaḷiṟukaḷaik koṇṭu ceyyum periya pōr keṭumāṟu; eḵku uyarttu - vēlum vāḷum ēnticceṉṟu; oḷiṟu vāḷ maṉṉar tutainilai koṉṟu - viḷaṅkukiṉṟa vāḷaiyuṭaiya pakai maṉṉar tammiṟ kūṭiniṉṟu porum pōrnilaiyaik koṉṟaḻittu; muracu kaṭippu aṭaiya - veṟṟimuracai ataṉ kaṭippu aṟaintu muḻakka; aruntuṟai pōki - ceytaṟkariya pōr ceyaṟkuriya tuṟai muṟṟavum kaṭaipōkac ceṉṟu; peruṅkaṭal nīntiya maram valiyuṟukkum paṇṇiya vilaiñar pōla - peruṅkaṭalaik kaṭantu ceṉṟu mīḷutalāl paḻutuṟṟa marakkalattiṉ paḻutu pōkkip paṇṭupōla valiyuṭait tākkum kaṭal vāṇikarpōla; peruṅkait toḻutiyiṉ puṇṇorīi vaṉtuyar kaḻippi - periya kaiyaiyuṭaiya yāṉaik kūṭṭam uṟṟa pōrppuṇkaḷai āṟṟi avaṟṟāl avai tuṉpuṟṟa valiya tuyarattaiyum pōkki; irantōr vāḻa nalki - muṟpōtil vantu irantavar vaṟumai nīṅki vāḻumāṟu koṭuttu; irappōrkku - piṟpōtil vantu irappōrukkum; ītal taṇṭāta - ītaliṉ kuṉṟāta; mā citaṟu irukkai - kutiraikaḷai varaiyātu vaḻaṅkum niṉ pācaṟai iruppiṉai; kaṇṭaṉeṉ celku vantaṉeṉ - kaṇṭu pōvāṉ vantēṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
kaḷiṟuṭaimai pōrkkup perumai tarutaliṉ “kaḷiṟuṭaip peruñ camam” eṉṟār; “yāṉaiyuṭaiya paṭaikāṇṭal muṉṉiṉitē” (iṉi. 40 : 5) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. tataital, keṭutal : “vēluṭaik kuḻūuc camantataiya nūṟi” (patiṟ. 66) eṉap piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka. tutai nilai, kūṭiyirukkum aṇi vakuppu. aṇinilaiyai yaḻitta vaḻi, vīrar paṭaiyum piṟa paṭaikaḷum oḻuṅkiṉṟit tāṟumāṟāyc citaṟi eḷitil aḻivarātaliṉ, “tutai nilai koṉṟu” eṉṟār. citaitteṉṉātu “koṉ” ṟeṉṟār, maṟuvalum tutaintu nilaipeṟā vakaiyil aḻittamai tōṉṟa. muracu kaṭippu aṭaiya eṉṟatu, muracu muḻaṅka eṉṟavāṟu. pōr muṟai veṭci mutalākap palvakaippaṭutaliṉ, “aruntuṟai pōki” eṉṟār. peruṅkaṭalaip pakaivar paṭaikkum, marakkalattaik kaḷiṟṟut toḻutikkum, paṇṇiya vilaiñaraic cēramāṉ vīrarukkum uvamamākak koḷka. peruṅkāṟṟum pēralaiyum mōtutalāl kaṭṭut taḷarnta kalattaik, karaicērntatum kaṭṭuṭaittākki valiyuṟuttal kalañ celuttuvōrkku iṉṟiyamaiyāc ceytiyākum. peruṅkaṭal nīntiya marameṉṟatu, marakkalattai. palvēṟu paṇṭaṅkaḷaiyum kalattiṟkoṇṭu vēṟu nāṭu ceṉṟu viṟṟup poruḷīṭṭutal paṟṟik kalattiṟ cellum kaṭal vāṇikaraip “paṇṇiya vilaiñar” eṉṟār. yāṉaikaṭkup pōriluṇṭākiya puṇṇāl mikka tuyaruṇṭāvatai yaṟintu puṇṇai yāṟṟu mukattāl tuyar pōkkutalāl, “puṇṇorīi vaṉṟuyar kaḻippi” yeṉṟār. vaṉṟuyar eṉṟataṉāl, uṟṟa puṇ perum puṇṇeṉ ṟaṟika. irantōr irappōr eṉa iṟap piṉum etirviṉum kūṟiya taṉāl piṟpoḻutu muṟpoḻutu koḷḷappaṭṭaṉa. muṟpoḻutu vantirantōr kaḷiṟu peṟṟuc ceṉṟamaiyiṉ, piṟpoḻutu varuvōrkkuk kutiraikaḷai vaḻaṅkalāṉāṉeṉa vuṇarka. eṇṇiṟantaṉavātaliṉ, kutirai kaḷaic citaṟiṉāṉ eṉṟār; ivai pakaivariṭattē peṟṟaṉa vām. iṉi, paḻaiya vuraikārarum, “mācita ṟirukkai yeṉṟatu pakaivariṭattuk koḷḷappaṭṭa mākkaḷai varaiyātu aḷa viṟakkak koṭukkum pācaṟai yirukkai yeṉṟavāṟu” eṉṟum, “ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟku mācita ṟirukkaiyeṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: vāṉam taḷi corinteṉac cillērāḷar pakaṉṟait teriyal kaliṅkam kaṭuppac cūṭit tirumaṇi peṟūum akaṉkaṇ vaippiṉ nāṭu kiḻavōy, peruñcamam tataiya eḵkuyarttu, maṉṉar tutainilai koṉṟu, aruntuṟai pōki, paṇṇiya vilaiñarpōlap peruṅkait toḻutiyiṉ puṇṇorīi vaṉṟuyar kaḻippi, irantōr vāḻa nalki, irappōrkku ītal taṇṭā mācita ṟirukkai kaṇṭaṉeṉ celku vantaṉeṉ eṉpatām. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “nāṭu kiḻavōy, maṉṉar peruñcamam tataiya eḵkuyarttu ammaṉṉar palar kūṭic ceṟinta nilaimaiyaik koṉṟu aruntuṟai pōkik  kaṭalai nīntiṉa marakkalattiṉai aḻivu cērātu valiyuṟukkum paṇṭavāṇikaraippōlak kait toḻutiyiṉ puṇṇai oruvuvittu valiya tuyaraik kaḻittup pōriṭattu viṉaiyiliruttalē vinōtamākakkoṇṭu irantōr vāḻa nalkip piṉṉum irappōrkku ītaliṉ māṟāta  mācita ṟirukkaiyaik kaṇṭu pōvēṉ vantēṉ eṉak kūṭṭi viṉai muṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ veṉṟic ciṟappum koṭaic ciṟappum kūṟiyavāṟām.”
7. veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkai
1.	eṉaipperum paṭaiyaṉō ciṉappōrp poṟaiyaṉ
	eṉṟaṉi rāyi ṉāṟucel vampalir              
	maṉpatai peyara varacukaḷat toḻiyak
	koṉṟutō ḷōcciya veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkai
5.	mīpiṇat turuṇṭa tēyā vāḻiyiṟ
	paṇṇamai tēru māvu mākkaḷum
	eṇṇaṟ karumaiyi ṉeṇṇiṉṟō vilaṉē
	kantukō ḷīyātu kāḻpala murukki
	ukakkum parunti ṉilattuniḻal cāṭic
10.	cēṇparaṉ murampi ṉīrmpaṭaik koṅkar
	āparan taṉṉapal celaviṉ
	yāṉaikāṇ palavaṉ ṟāṉai yāṉē.
tuṟai	:	uḻiñai yaravam
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkai
1-2. eṉaipperum paṭaiyaṉō ............ vampalir
urai :
āṟu cel vampalir - ivvaḻiyē cellum putuvōrkaḷē; ciṉap pōrp poṟaiyaṉ - ciṉattuṭaṉ pōrai veṟṟi yuṇṭākac ceyyum peruñcēra lirumpoṟai; eṉaip perum paṭaiyaṉō eṉṟaṉirāyiṉ - ettuṇaip periya paṭaiyai yuṭaiyavaṉō eṉṟu kēṭkiṉṟīrāyiṉ, kūṟuval kēṇmiṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
vampalar, putuvōr. “ārum aruvum īroṭu civaṇum” (tol. viḷi. 21) eṉṟataṉāl, vampalir eṉa vantatu, irantōrkku eṇṇiṟanta kaḷiṟukaḷaiyum irappōrkku aḷaviṟanta mākkaḷaiyum citaṟutalaik kāṇpōrkkum, cellumiṭantōṟum veṟṟiyē peṟakkāṇpōrkkum poṟaiyaṉatu paṭaip perumai yaṟitaṟku vēṭkai nikaḻu mātaliṉ, “eṉaip perum paṭaiyaṉō eṉṟaṉi rāyiṉ” eṉṟār. eṉaip perum paṭaiyaṉō eṉṟatu vampalar kūṟṟiṉaik koṇṭu kūṟiyatu. ciṉattiṉ viḷaivu pōrum, ap pōriṉ viḷaivu veṉṟiyumātaliṉ, “ciṉappōrp poṟai yaṉ” eṉṟu ciṟappittār. kūṟutal kēṇmiṉ eṉpatu eñci niṉṟatu.
3-7. maṉpatai ........... ilaṉē
urai :
maṉpatai peyara - pakaippaṭaiyiluḷḷa vīrar aḻin
tōṭa vum; aracu kaḷat toḻiya - pakaiyaracar pōrkkaḷattē paṭṭu vīḻavum; koṉṟu - ap pakaivaraik koṉṟu; tōḷōcciya veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkai - tōḷai yuyarttik kaivīciyāṭiya veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkaiyiṉai yuṭaiyarāyp paṭṭu vīḻnta; mī piṇattu - avar piṇattiṉmītu; uruṇṭa tēyā āḻiyiṉ - uruṇṭōṭiya vāytēyāta cakkarattai yuṭaiya; paṇṇamai tērum - kaṭukic cellutaṟ kēṟpap paṇṇutalamainta tērkaḷum; māvum mākkaḷum - kutirai kaḷum kālāṭkaḷum; eṇṇaṟ karumaiyiṉ - eṇṇa muṭiyāta aḷavilamaintiruttalāl; eṇṇiṉṟō vilaṉ - eṇṇiṟṟilēṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
pakaivarpaṭaivīrarai maṉpatai (Mob) yeṉṟār, vīrar eṉappaṭaṟkuriya aḻiyāmai avarpāl iṉmaiyiṉ. uyir nīṅkiyavaḻi araca pōkamum oḻitaliṉ, “aracu kaḷattoḻiya” veṉṟār. vīrar pōril pakaivarai veṉṟu appōrk kaḷattē kaiyai vīcit tuṇaṅkaiyāṭit tam veṉṟi makiḻcci yāl iṉpuṟuva rātaliṉ, ak kūttiṉai “veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkai” yeṉṟār. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkaip piṇam eṉṟatu ūrkaḷilē yāṭum”tuṇaṅkai yaṉṟik kaḷaṅkaḷilē veṉṟāṭiṉa tuṇaṅkaiyaiyuṭaiya piṇam eṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟku veṉṟāṭu tuṇaṅkai yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar. aracu kaḷattoḻiya veṉṟa taṟkup paḻaiyavurai kārar, “aracaraik kaḷattilē uṭaloḻintu kiṭakkak koṉṟeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “koṉṟu tōḷōcciya piṇam eṉak kūṭṭi, muṉpu tammuṭaṉ pakaittavaraik koṉṟu tōṉōcciyāṭi ippoḻutu ivaṉ kaḷattiṟ paṭṭuk kiṭakkiṉṟa vīrar piṇameṉa av vīrar ceytiyai ap piṇattiṉmēlēṟṟic colliyavāṟāka vuraikka” eṉṟum, “mī piṇattaip piṇamī yeṉak koḷka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar. eṇṇiṟṟō veṉaṟpālatu melintu niṉṟatu.
8-12. kantu ........... tāṉaiyāṉē
urai :
kantu kōḷīyātu - kaṭṭuttaṟiyōṭu piṇippuṇṭaṟku iṭantarātu; kāḻpala murukki - kuttukkōl palavaṟṟaiyum citaittu; ukakkum paruntiṉ nilattu niḻal cāṭi - uyarntu paṟakkum paruntiṉatu nilattiṭattē vīḻum niḻalaic ciṉantu pāyum; cēṇ paral murampiṉ - cēṇiṭameṅkum paranta parukkaik kaṟkaḷaiyuṭaiya murampu nilattilē; īrmpaṭaik koṅkar ā parantaṉṉa - īriya paṭaiyiṉai yuṭaiya koṅ karuṭaiya āṉiraikaḷ parantu celvatupōṉṟa; celaviṉ pal yāṉai - celaviṉaiyuṭaiya palavākiya yāṉaikaḷai; avaṉ tāṉaiyāṉ - avaṉuṭaiya tāṉaiyilē; kāṇpal - kāṇkiṉṟēṉē yaṉṟi avai ittuṇai yeṉṟu aṟintilēṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
kantiṉiṭattē piṇittaṟku aṭaṅkātu ak kantiṉai muṟit taḻittal paṟṟi, “kantu kōḷīyātu” eṉṟum, kuttappaṭum kuttuk kōl av yāṉaikaḷiṉ uṭaliṟpaṭṭu ūṭuruvum valiyiṉmai yiṉ citaintupōvatu tōṉṟa, “kāḻpala murukki” yeṉṟum. poruḷallāta niḻalaiyum pakaip poruḷākak karutic ciṉavutaṟ kēṟṟa matakkaḷippuṭaimaipaṟṟi, “ukakkum paruntiṉ nilattu niḻal cāṭi” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. piṇip puṇṇā teṉṉum poruṭ ṭāya “kōḷīyātu” eṉṉum etirmaṟai viṉaiyeccat tiricol murukki cāṭi yeṉṉum ecca viṉaikaḷuṭaṉ aṭukki niṉṟu “celaviṉ” eṉpataik koṇṭu muṭintaṉa. ukattal, uyartal.
kaṇṇuk keṭṭiya vaḷavum paral niṟainta murampu nilamē kāṇappaṭutal paṟṟi “cēṇ paral murampu” eṉṟum, nīr vēṇṭik kūval mutaliyaṉa tōṇṭutaṟkuriya kuntāli mutaliya paṭaikaḷai “īrm paṭai” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. koṅkar ākkaḷ palavuṭaiya reṉpatai “ā keḻu koṅkar” (patiṟ. 22) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka. yāṉaik kūṭṭattiṉ mikutiyiṉai āṉiraik kūṭṭattai yuvamaṅ kāṭṭi yuraittal marapu; “erumai yaṉṉa karuṅkal liṭaitō, ṟāṉiṟ parakkum yāṉaiya” (puṟam. 5) eṉṟu cāṉṟōr uraippatu kāṇka.
“pal yāṉai kāṇpal” eṉṟataṉāl avaṟṟai ittuṇai yeṉa veṇṇaṟ karumai peṟappaṭṭatu.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu, āṟu cel vampalir, ciṉap pōrp poṟaiyaṉ eṉaip paṭaiyaṉō eṉṟaṉirāyiṉ, avaṉuṭaiya tērummāvum mākkaḷum eṇṇaṟ karumaiyiṉ eṇṇiṉṟō vilaṉ; avaṉ tāṉaiyilē koṅkar ā parantaṉṉa celaviṉ pal yāṉai kāṇpal; avaṟṟaiyum ittuṇaiya veṉṟu eṇṇiṟṟilēṉ eṉpatām. iṉi, paḻaiyavuraikārar, “vampalir, poṟaiyaṉ eṉaip perumpaṭaiyaṉ eṉṟaṉirāyiṉ avaṉ tāṉaiyiṭattut tērum māvum mākkaḷum eṇṇaṟ karumaiyiṉ eṇṇiṟṟilaṉ; āyiṉ avaṉ tāṉaiyiṉ yāṉai tāṉ eṇṇiṉaiyō veṉiṉ, atuvum eṇṇiṉēṉallēṉ; kaṭpulaṉukku varaiyaṟaippaṭṭatupōla āparantālotta celaviṟ pala yāṉaiyai avaṉ tāṉaiyāṉē kāṇpal eṉak kūṭṭi viṉai muṭivu ceyka,” eṉpar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ paṭaip perumaic ciṟappuk kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.”
“ip pāṭṭiṟ potuppaṭap paṭaiyeḻucci kūṟiyataṉai uḻiñai yarava meṉṟatu, āṇṭu appaṭai yeḻuṅ kālattu nocci matiṟpōr kuṟitteḻuntatai oru kāraṇattāl aṟintu pōlum,” eṉṟu paḻaiyavurai kūṟiyatu ārāyat takkatu.
8. piṟaḻa nōkkiyavar
1.	valampaṭu muraci ṉilaṅkuvaṉa viḻūum 	avveḷ ḷaruvi yuvvarai yatuvē 	cilvaḷai viṟali celkuvai yāyiṉ
	vaḷḷitaḻt tāmarai neytalo ṭarintu
5.	melliyaṉ makaḷi rolkuvaṉa riyalik
	kiḷikaṭi mēvalar puṟavutoṟu nuvalap
	palpaya ṉilaiiya kaṭaṟuṭai vaippiṉ
	velpō rāṭavar maṟampurintu kākkum
	vilpayi liṟumpiṟ ṟakaṭūr nūṟi
10.	pēe mamaṉṟa piṟaḻanōk kiyavar
	ōṭuṟu kaṭumuraṇ ṭumiyac ceṉṟu
	vemmuṉai taputta kālait tannāṭ
	ṭiyāṭuparan taṉṉa māviṉ
	āparan taṉṉa yāṉaiyōṉ kuṉṟē.
tuṟai	:	viṟaliyāṟṟuppaṭai
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	piṟaḻa nōk kiyavar
3. cilvaḷai ............ yāyiṉ
urai :
cilvaḷai viṟali - cilavākiya vaḷaikaḷai yaṇinta viṟaliyē; celkuvaiyāyiṉ - peruñ cēral irumpoṟai pāl cella virumpiṉaiyāyiṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
viṟaliyaic cēramāṉiṭattē āṟṟuppaṭukkiṉṟārātaliṉ, cilvaḷai viṟaliyeṉac ciṟappittār. viṟalpaṭap pāṭiyāṭu makaḷātaliṉ āṭumiṭattu vaḷai palavāyavaḻi oṉṟiṉoṉṟu tākkiyuṭaiyumātalāl cilavē yaṇital avaṭku iyalpu eṉa aṟika. iṉi, palvaḷaiyiṭum paruvattāḷallaḷeṉpatu tōṉṟa ivvāṟu kūṟiṉāreṉṟumām. cēramāṉpāl cellum karuttuṭaiyaḷātalaic collālum kuṟippālum terivittā ḷātalāl “celkuvaiyāyiṉ” eṉṟār.
4-14. vaḷḷitaḻ ......... kuṉṟē
urai :
melliyal makaḷir olkuvaṉar iyali - melliya iyalpiṉaiyuṭaiya makaḷir acaintu naṭantu maruta vayaṟkuc ceṉṟu; vaḷitaḻt tāmarai neytaloṭu arintu - vaḷaviya itaḻkaḷaiyuṭaiya tāmaraip pūvaiyum neytaṟ pūvaiyum koytukoṇṭu; puṟavutoṟum kiḷi kaṭi mēvalar nuvala - mullaip pulattukkuc ceṉṟu āṇṭuḷḷa puṉantōṟum vantu paṭiyum kiḷikaḷai yōppum viruppuṭaiyarāyk kiḷi kaṭi pāṭṭaip pāṭa; palpayaṉ nilaiiya kaṭaṟuṭai vaippiṉ - palvakaip payaṉkaḷum nilaipeṟṟa kāṭṭiṭattu ūrkaḷaiyum; vel pōr āṭavar maṟam purintu kākkum vil payil iṟumpiṉ - vellukiṉṟa pōrai yuṭaiya vīrar maṟamē virumpik kāttaṟ ṟoḻilaic ceyyum viṟpaṭai nirampiya kāvaṟkāṭṭaiyu muṭaiya; takaṭūr nūṟi - takaṭūrai yaḻittu; pēem amaṉṟa piṟaḻa nōkku iyavar - kaṇṭārkku accattai yuṇṭupaṇṇum pakaivaraip piṟaḻntu nōkkum pārvaiyiṉaiyum pala iyaṅkaḷaiyumuṭaiya pakaivīraruṭaiya; ōṭuṟu kaṭumuraṇ tumiyac ceṉṟu - tammōṭu etirttār tōṟṟōṭutaṟkuk kāraṇamāṉa vali keṭumāṟu mēṟceṉṟu; vemmuṉai taputta kālai - avaratu koṭiya pōrmuṉaiyaip porutaḻitta kālattu; tam nāṭṭu yāṭu parantaṉṉa māviṉ - ap pakaivar nāṭṭilē āṭukaḷ parantāṟpōlap parantu tōṉṟum kutiraikaḷaiyum; ā parantaṉṉa yāṉaiyōṉ kuṉṟu - ākkaḷ parantāṟ pōlap parantu tōṉṟum yāṉai
kaḷaiyu muṭaiyaṉākiya cēramāṉatu kuṉṟu eṉṟavāṟu.
iyalpākavē meṉmaittaṉmaiyum ataṉāl acainta naṭaiyu muṭaiyavarātaliṉ makaḷirai, “melliyal makaḷir olkuvaṉa riyali” yeṉṟār. tāmaraiyum neytalum arintamai kūṟiyataṉāl, maruta vayal peṟappaṭṭatu. oṭu, eṇṇoṭu. aṇmaiyilē mullaippuṟavu miruttaliṉ, marutanilañ ceṉṟa makaḷir, uṭaṉē mullaippuṟavu cēṟalaiyum kūṟiṉār. puṟavu cēṟaṟkuk kāraṇam iḵteṉpār, “kiḷikaṭi mēvalar” eṉṟār. mullai mutaliya nāṉilappayaṉum oruṅku peṟumāṟu tōṉṟa, “palpayaṉ nilaiiya kaṭaṟuṭai vaippiṉ” eṉṟār. iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, “makaḷir iyali neytaloṭu tāmarai yarintu kiḷikaṭi mēvalar puṟavutoṟum nuvalap palpayaṉ nilaiiya kaṭaṟu eṉakkūṭṭik kiḷikaṭi makaḷir nilavaṇumai yāṉē marutanilattilē ceṉṟu neytaloṭu tāmarai yarintu, piṉ kiḷikaṭi toḻilai mēvutalaiyuṭaiya
rāyp puṟaviṉ puṉaṅkaṭōṟum kiḷikaṭi pāṭalai nuvalap palpayaṅkaḷum nilaipeṟṟa mullai nilameṉa vuraikka” eṉṟār.
vaippiṉaiyum iṟumpiṉaiyumuṭaiya takaṭūreṉa iyai yum. “vaippiṉ takaṭūr eṉak kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum, “āṭavar kākkum iṟumpeṉak kūṭṭuka,” veṉṟum paḻaiyavuraikārar kūṟuvar. vilpayil iṟumpu, villēntiya vīrarpaṭai yirukkum iṟumpu. pēem, accam. kaṇṭārkku accattai yuṇṭupaṇṇum pārvaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya vīrar, pakaivarai nērē nōkkātu eṭuttum paṭuttum kōṭṭiyum pārkkum iyalpupaṟṟi, “piṟaḻa nōkkiyava” reṉṟār; paḻaiyavuraikārarum, “piṟaḻa nōkkiyava reṉṟatu, tam ciṉamikutiyāṉē māṟṟār paṭait tōṟṟattiṉai neṟiyāl nōkkātu eṭuttum paṭuttum kōṭṭiyum palapaṭap piṟaḻa nōkkum pakaivarākiya palliya muṭaiyāreṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟkup piṟaḻa nōkkiyavareṉṟu peyarāyiṟ,” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar. neṟiyāl nōkkiyavaḻi, paṭaiyiluḷḷāriṟ palar iṉiyarum neruṅkiya muṟaiyiṉaru māyk kāṇappaṭuvareṉṟum, akkālai yavarpāl kaṇṇōṭu māyiṉ maṟam vāṭu meṉṟum karutip piṟaḻa nōkkuvatu vīrarkku iyalpākaliṉālum, appiṟaḻcci nōkkiṟku āṇṭu iyampum iyaṅkaḷ tuṇaiyākaliṉālum paṭaivīraraip “piṟaḻa nōkkiyavar” eṉṟār. ic ciṟappālē it toṭar ippāṭṭiṟkup peyarāyiṟṟeṉak kōṭal cīriteṉa vaṟika. piṟaḻcci nōkkam kaṇṭārkku accam
payakkum taṉmaikaḷ niṟaintiruttal paṟṟip “pēem amaṉṟa” eṉṟāreṉka. iṉi ivviyavaratu valinilai kūṟuvār, “ōṭuṟu kaṭumuraṇ” eṉṟār. ivviyavar takaṭūraik kāttu
niṉṟa pakaivīrar. appakaivar koṅkarātalāl, avarpāl uḷḷa yāṭukaḷiṉ paṉmaiyum ākkaḷiṉ paṉmaiyum uṇarttuvār, “tannāṭṭu yāṭu parantaṉṉa māviṉ” eṉṟum, “āparantaṉṉa yāṉai” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “māviṉoṭu veṉa oṭu virittu muṉai taputtakālai māviṉoṭu ā parantaṉṉa yāṉaiyōṉ eṉa viṉaimuṭivu ceyka,” eṉṟār.
1-2. valampaṭu ........... yatuvē
urai :
uvvarai - uvvellaiyil uḷḷa; valampaṭu muraciṉ - veṟṟiyiṭattu muḻaṅkum muracupōla; ilaṅkuvaṉa viḻūum av veḷḷaruvi atu - muḻakkamum viḷakkamu muṭaiyavāy vīḻkiṉṟa aḻakiya veḷḷiya aruvikaḷaiyuṭaiya atuvākum eṉṟavāṟu.
varai, ellai. tōṉṟukiṉṟa kuṉṟukaḷil uyarntu aruvikaḷai yuṭaittāyt tōṉṟum kuṉṟiṉai “atu” eṉac cuṭṭik kāṭṭukiṉṟārātaliṉ, “uvvarai av veḷḷaruvi yatuvē” eṉṟār. peru muḻakkam eḻutaliṉ, veṟṟi muraciṉai yuvamam kūṟiṉār. “valampaṭu muracu” eṉavē veṟṟi muracātal peṟṟām. viḷakkam kūṟavē muḻakka muṇmai peṟappaṭṭatu.
itukāṟum kūṟiyavāṟṟāl, “cilvaḷai viṟali, celkuvai yāyiṉ yāṉaiyōṉ kuṉṟu uvvellaiyil veḷḷaruviyai yuṭaiya atu eṉa māṟikkūṭṭi viṉaimuṭivu ceyka.”
itaṉāṟ colliyatu avaṉ veṉṟic ciṟappuk kūṟiyavāṟā yiṟṟu.
9. niṟampaṭu kuruti
1.	uyirpōṟ ṟalaiyē ceruvat tāṉē
	koṭaipōṟ ṟalaiyē yiravalar naṭuvaṇ
	periyōrp pēṇic ciṟiyōrai yaḷitti
	niṉvayiṟ pirinta nallicai kaṉaviṉum
5.	piṟarnacai yaṟiyā vayaṅkucen nāviṉ
	paṭiyōrt tēytta vāṇmait toṭiyōr
	tōḷiṭaik kuḻainta kōtai mārpa
	aṉaiya vaḷapparuṅ kuraiyai yataṉāl
	niṉṉoṭu vārār tannilat toḻintu
10.	kolkaḷiṟ ṟiyāṉai yeruttam pulleṉa
	vilkulai yaṟuttuk kōliṉ vārā
	velpōr vēntar muracukaṇ pōḻntavar
	aracuvā vaḻaippak kōṭaṟut tiyaṟṟiya
	aṇaṅkuṭai marapiṟ kaṭṭiṉmē liruntu
15.	tumpai cāṉṟa meytayaṅ kuyakkattu
	niṟampaṭu kuruti puṟampaṭi ṉallatu
	maṭaiyetir koḷḷā vañcuvaru marapiṟ
	kaṭavu ḷayiraiyi ṉilaiik
	kēṭila vāka perumaniṉ pukaḻē.
tuṟai	:	centuṟaip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	niṟampaṭu kuruti 
1-8. uyir ........... kuraiyai.
urai :
vayaṅku cen nāviṉ - meymmai moḻiyāl viḷakkam poruntiya cevviya nāviṉaiyum; paṭiyōr tēytta āṇmai - vaṇaṅkātārai valiyaḻitta āṇmaiyiṉaiyum; toṭiyōr tōḷiṭaik kuḻainta kōtai mārpa - toṭi yaṇinta makaḷir tōḷaik kūṭutalāl kuḻainta mālai yaṇinta mārpaiyu muṭaiya vēntē; ceruvattāṉ uyir pōṟṟalai - pōrilē nī uyiraip poruḷākak karutiṟṟilai; iravalar naṭuvaṇ koṭai pōṟṟalai - paricil vēṇṭi varum irappōr kūṭṭattilē koṭukkuñ ceyalil etaṉaiyum eṉṟum varaitalai yaṟiyāy; periyōrp pēṇic ciṟiyōrai aḷitti - periyōrkaḷait tamarākap pēṇikkoṇṭu āṟṟalāṟ ciṟiya rāyiṉāraiyum puṟak kaṇiyātu aruḷ ceykiṉṟāy; pirinta niṉvayiṉ nallicai - ellāt ticaiyiṉum ceṉṟu paravi yirukkum niṉ nalla pukaḻkaḷ; kaṉaviṉum piṟar nacai yaṟiyā - kaṉavilum tammai virumpum piṟarai virumpic cellāvāyiṉa; aṉaiya aḷapparuṅ kuraiyai - at taṉmaiyavākiya aḷattaṟ kariya kuṇañ ceyalkaḷai yuṭaiyaiyā yirukkiṉṟāy eṉṟavāṟu.
nāviṟku viḷakkam tāṉ vaḻaṅkum meymmai moḻi yālum, cemmai, yātoṉṟum tīmaiyilāta collutalālu mātaliṉ “vayaṅku cennāviṉ” eṉṟār. paṭiyār, paṭiyō reṉa niṉṟatu; paṭiyār, vaṇaṅkātār; “paṭiyōrt tēytta paṇivi lāṇmai” 1 (malaipaṭu. 423) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka. paṭital - vaṇaṅkutal. “paṭiyō reṉṟatu piratiyō reṉṉum vaṭamoḻit tirivu” (akam. 22) eṉa akanāṉūṟṟu arumpatavuraikārar kūṟiyatu coṉṉilai yuṇarātu kūṟiya tākaliṉ poruntāmai yaṟika. makaḷir muyakkiṭai mārpi laṇinta tārumālaiyuṅ  kuḻaiyumātaliṉ “toṭiyōr tōḷiṭaik kuḻainta kōtai mārpa” eṉṟār; “kātal koḷḷāp, palliruṅ kūntal makaḷir, ollā muyakkiṭaik kuḻaika veṉtārē” (puṟam. 73) eṉac cōḻaṉ nalaṅkiḷḷi kūṟṟālum ītaṟiyappaṭum.
ceru. ammuppeṟṟuc ceruvameṉa vantatu. ceruviṉkaṇ piṟakkum pukaḻmēṟ ceṉṟa vēṭkaiyāl uyiraip poru ḷākak karutiṟṟilaṉātaliṉ. “uyir pōṟṟalaiyē ceruvat tāṉē” eṉṟār; “cuḻalu micaivēṇṭi vēṇṭā vuyirār” (kuṟaḷ. 777) eṉac cāṉṟōr kūṟutal kāṇka. īttuvakkum iṉpattālum īkaikkaṇ icai niṟpatālum varaiyātu vaḻaṅkum vaṇmai yuṭaiyataṉāl kaṇṭu “koṭai pōṟṟalaiyē iravalar naṭuvaṇ” eṉṟār. koṭai pōṟṟāmaiyāvatu “iṉṟu celiṉun tarumē ciṟuvarai, niṉṟu celiṉun tarumē piṉṉum, muṉṉē tantaṉeṉeṉṉātu tuṉṉi, vaikalum celiṉum poyyala ṉāki” (puṟam. 171) irappōr vēṇṭiya vēṇṭi yāṅku vaḻaṅkuvatu. periyāraip pēṇikkoḷal aracarkkup peruvaṉmaiyātalāl, “periyōrp pēṇi” yeṉṟār; “tammiṟ periyār tamarā voḻukutal, vaṉmaiyu ḷellān talai” (kuṟaḷ. 444) eṉac cāṉṟōrum paṇittār. ciṟiyōreṉ  ṟatu aṟivu, āṇmai, poruḷ, paṭai mutaliyavaṟṟāl taṉṉiṟ ciṟumaiyuṭaiyārai. avarai yaḷittōmpalum ceṅkōṉmai yātaliṉ, “ciṟiyōrai yaḷitti” eṉṟār; “vallā rāyiṉum valluna rāyiṉum, varunti vantōr maruṅku nōkki, aruḷa vallai yākumati” (puṟam. 27) eṉac cāṉṟōr kūṟum mutumoḻik kāñciyāṉumaṟika. niṉvayiṉ nallicai, pirinta nallicaiyeṉa iyaiyum. pukaḻvarum vāyilkaḷ kalvi, āṇmai mutalākap palavātaliṉ, pukaḻum palavātal paṟṟi, “nallicai yaṟiyā” eṉap paṉmaiyāṟ kūṟiṉār. oruvaṉ pukaḻkku avaṉ kāraṇa māyiṉum, avaṉait taṉakku ātāra mākak koḷḷātu avaṉiṟ pirintuceṉṟu ulakattai ātāra mākak koṇṭu avaṉ maṭiyiṉum tāṉ maṭiyātu niṉṟu nilavuvatu pukaḻkkiyal pātaliṉ, “niṉvayiṟ pirinta nallicai” yeṉṟār. pukaḻ taṉṉaic ceytōṉiṟ piriyātu avaṉōṭē kiṭakkumāyiṉ, avaṉ poṉṟuṅkāṟ ṟāṉum poṉṟu meṉpatupaṭṭuk kuṟṟamāy muṭitaliṉ, “pirinta nallicai” eṉac ciṟappittār. ik karuttēpaṟṟip paḻaiyavurai kārarum, “pirinta niṉ vayiṉ nallicai yeṉak kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum, “pirital taṉṉaiviṭṭut  tikku vitikkukaḷilē pōtal” eṉṟum kūṟutal kāṇka. “niṉvayiṟ pirinta nallicai” yeṉak kiṭantapaṭiyē koṇṭu, “niṉpāṉiṉṟum pirintu ceṉṟa niṉatu nallicaikaḷ” eṉpāru muḷar; niṉpāṉiṉṟum pirintu ceṉṟa eṉṟavaḻi niṉṉiṉ nīṅkiya pukaḻeṉṟākip poruḷ ciṟavā toḻitaliṉ, atu poruḷaṉmai yaṟika. nī peṟṟuḷḷa pukaḻkaḷaip piṟar kaṉavilum peṟṟaṟiyār eṉpār, pukaḻ mēlēṟṟi, niṉ nallicai “kaṉavilum piṟar nacai yaṟiyā” eṉṟār. “nacai yaṟiyā” eṉṟa taṉāl, niṉ pakaimaikkañcip piṟar kaṉaviṉum nī peṟṟa pukaḻ kaḷaip peṟutaṟku virumpuvatilar eṉpatu kūṟiya vāṟāyiṟṟu.
ivvāṟu uyir pōṟṟāmaiyāl āṇmaiyum, koṭai pōṟṟāmaiyāl vaṇmaiyum periyōrp pēṇic ciṟi yōrai yaḷittalāl ceṅkōṉmaiyum piṟavum aḷattaṟ kariyavā yiruttalāl, ēṉaiya piṟavum attaṉmaiyavē yeṉpār, “aṉaiya vaḷapparuṅ kuraiyai” yeṉṟār.
8-19. ataṉāl .............. niṉ pukaḻē
urai :
ataṉāl - ātalāl; niṉṉoṭu vārār - niṉ viruppap paṭi yoḻukutaṟ kicaiyāmal; tam nilattu oḻintu - niṉakku māṟupaṭṭut taṅkaḷ nāṭṭilēyē yiruntu; kol kaḷiṟṟu yāṉai eruttam pulleṉa vilkulai yaṟuttu - niṉṉai yetirtta piṟa vēntar tām ēṟivanta kollukiṉṟa kaḷiṟṟiyāṉaiyiṉ piṭari pulleṉṉumāṟu avar ēṟṟup poruta villiṉ nāṇai yaṟuttu avaraik koṉṟu nī veṟṟi mēmpaṭak kaṇṭum; kōliṉ vārā vel pōr vēntar - niṉ ceṅkōṟ kīḻp paṇintu varutalaic ceyyātu, velkiṉṟa pōr ceytalaiyuṭaiya vēntaratu; muracukaṇ pōḻntu - muḻakkum muraciṉ kaṇṇaik kiḻittu; avar aracuvā aḻaippa - avarkaḷuṭaiya paṭṭat tiyāṉai kataṟak kataṟa; kōṭu aṟuttu iyaṟṟiya aṇaṅkuṭai marapiṉ kaṭṭiṉ mēl iruntu - ataṉ kōṭṭiṉai yaṟuttuc ceyta teyvat taṉmai poruntiya muṟaimaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya kaṭṭiliṉmēl iruntu; tumpai cāṉṟa mey tayaṅku uyakkattu - tumpai cūṭip porutalil amainta meyyiṭattē yuṇṭākiya acaivupaṟṟip piṟanta ōyccaluṭaṉ; niṟampaṭu kuruti puṟam paṭiṉ allatu - mārpiṟ paṭṭa puṇṇiṭat toḻukum kurutiyāṟ puṟattē teḷikkappaṭṭālaṉṟi; maṭai etir koḷḷā - koṭukkappaṭum paṭaiccalai (paliyai) yēṟṟuk koḷḷāta; añcu varumarapiṉ - accam poruntiya muṟaimai yiṉaiyuṭaiya; kaṭavuḷ ayiraiyiṉ - koṟṟavai vīṟṟiruk kiṉṟa ayirai malaipōla; peruma - perumāṉē; niṉ pukaḻ nilaiik kēṭilavāka - niṉ pukaḻkaḷum nilaipeṟṟuk keṭātu viḷaṅkuvaṉavāka eṉṟavāṟu.
ataṉāl eṉpataṉai nilaiik kēṭilavāka eṉpataṉōṭu iyaikka. tam maṉattuḷḷa māṟupāṭṭāl niṉ viruppuvaḻi yoḻukutaṟku icaintila reṉpār, “vārār” eṉṟār. vārātu irunta nilai iḵteṉṟaṟkut “tannilat toḻintu” eṉṟār. oḻinteṉavē, avarpāl ceyalaṟuti peṟappaṭṭatu. iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, “niṉṉoṭu vārār tannilat toḻin teṉṟatu, niṉṉai vaḻipaṭṭu niṉṉoṭu oḻukā tiruttalē yaṉṟit tam nilattilē vēṟupaṭṭu niṉ ṟeṉṟavā” ṟeṉpar.
niṉ viruppuvaḻi yoḻukutaṟku icaiviṉṟit tam nilattē vaṟitiruttalum māṉamātaliṉ pōrkku varalāṉār atu ceyyātu paṇintu niṉ kōṟkīḻ varaṟpālar eṉpār, “kōliṉ vārā”  eṉṟār. kōliṉ varutalē ceyaṟpāṟ ṟeṉpataṟku ētuk kūṟuvār, iṭaiyilē nikaḻnta nikaḻcciyai yeṭuttōtaluṟṟu, “kolkaḷiṟṟu yāṉai yeruttam pulleṉa vilkulai yaṟuttu” eṉṟār. aṟuppa veṉpatu aṟut teṉa niṉṟatu. kaṇṭum eṉa oru col varuvikka. “yāṉai yeruttam poliyak kuṭainiḻaṟ kīḻc, cēṉait talaivarāy” (nālaṭi. 3) vantārātaliṉ, vanta avarai veṉṟu mēmpaṭṭa ceytiyai, “yāṉai yeruttam pulleṉa vilkulai yaṟuttu” eṉṟār. kōliṉ vārāta vēntar pōr kuṟittu vantamai tōṉṟa, “velpōr vēntar” eṉṟār. iṉip paḻaiyavurai kārar, “yāṉai yeruttam pulleṉa vilkulai yaṟuttuk kōliṉ vārā vēnta reṉṟatu, muṉpu niṉ vaḻi yoḻukātu oḻintiruntavaḻip piṉpu tām kaḷattu niṉ pōrvalikaṇṭu iṉi niṉ vaḻi yoḻukutumeṉac collit tām ēṟiya yāṉai yeruttam pulleṉa villiṉ nāṇiyai yaṟuttu niṉ ceṅkōlvaḻi yoḻukāta vēntareṉṟavā” ṟeṉpar.
pakai vēntarai “vel pōr vēntar”  eṉṟār, itaṟku muṉpellām avar ceyta pōraṉaittiṉum veṉṟiyē yeyti vantamaiyum, accerukkē paṟṟukkōṭāka ippōtum vantāreṉpatum uṇarttutaṟku. ip pōril tōṟṟamaiyāl avaratu muracum kaḷattē yoḻinta teṉṟaṟku, “avar muracukaṇ kiḻittu” eṉṟār.
itukāṟum tām peṟṟuppōnta veṉṟiyāl tammaiyē viyantu tam paṭṭattiyāṉaimēl vantavar, pōriṟpaṭṭu vīḻntamaiyiṉ, avaratu avyāṉaiyaippaṟṟi aḵtu āṟṟātu kataṟip pulampip piḷiṟa ataṉ kōṭṭiṉai yaṟuttu ataṉāl palikkaṭṭil ceytu koṇṭa ceytiyai “aracuvā vaḻaippak kōṭaṟut tiyaṟṟiya kaṭṭil” eṉṟum, koṟṟavaikkup paliyiṭuvatu kuṟittu viḻuppuṇpaṭṭa vīrar ataṉmītiruntu tam mārpiṟ puṇṇiṉoḻukum kuruti teḷittu maṭai koṭuppa, teyvamum ataṉai virumpi yēṟpatu kuṟittu akkaṭṭilē, “aṇaṅkuṭai marapiṟ kaṭṭil” eṉṟum, ataṉ mītiruntu kuruti viraviya maṭai koṭuppiṉaṉṟi yēlāta teyvam añcattakum muṟaimai yuṭaittātal paṟṟi, “añcuvaru marapiṟ kaṭavuḷ” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār.
tumpai cūṭip porum vīrar, pakaivarai yeṟikaiyil tāmum mukattiṉum mārpiṉum puṇpaṭṭu meytaḷara ōycca leytiyapōtum tam mārpiṟ puṇṇiṉ kurutiyaic ciṟitum tayaṅkātu aḷḷi maṭaiyiṉ puṟattē teḷippavātaliṉ, “tumpai cāṉṟa meytayaṅ kuyakkattu niṟampaṭu kuruti” yeṉṟār. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “tumpai cāṉṟa mey tayaṅkuyak kattu niṟampaṭu kuruti yeṉṟatu, vīraruṭaiya, tumpai cūṭiyataṟ kēṟpa niṉṟu porutalāṟṟalaiyuṭaiya uṭalāṉatu acaiyum paṭi vanta ōyviṉaiyuṭaiya niṟaṅkaḷait tiṟantuviṭṭa kuruti yeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “allāta iṭaṅkaḷiṟ kuruti koḷḷāmaiyiṉ niṟaṅkaḷait tiṟakka āṇṭuṇṭāṉa kuruti yeṉpatāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum, “icciṟappāṉē itaṟku niṟampaṭu kuruti yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
ivvāṟē, “kōṭaṟut tiyaṟṟiya kaṭṭiṉmēliruntu niṟam paṭu kuruti puṟampaṭi ṉallatu maṭai yetirkoḷḷāk kaṭavuḷ eṉak kūṭṭi, avvāṟu ceytatoru kaṭṭil koṭu vantiṭṭataṉmēliruntu avvāṟu koṭuppatoru paliyuṇṭāyi ṉallatu palikoḷḷāk kaṭavuḷeṉa vuraikka” eṉṟum, “kaṭṭil mēliruntallatu kuruti puṟampaṭiṉallatu eṉa alla teṉpataṉai iraṇṭiṭattum kūṭṭik koḷka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
“niṟampaṭu kuruti puṟampaṭi ṉallatu maṭai yetirkoḷḷāk kaṭavuḷ” eṉavē, koṟṟavai yeṉpatu peṟṟām. ayirai, cirāppaḷḷikku mēṟkil kāviriyiṉ teṟkiluḷḷatoru kuṉṟu; itaṉai ikkālattār aivarmalai yeṉṟu vaḻaṅkumeṉ pāru muḷar. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “atu koṟṟavai yuṟaiva toru malai” yeṉpar. ayiraimalai niṉṟu nilaipeṟuvatu pōla niṉ pukaḻkaḷum nilaipeṟṟu viḷaṅkuka eṉpār, “ayiraiyiṉ nilaiik kēṭilavāka niṉ pukaḻē” yeṉṟār.
itukāṟum kūṟiyavāṟṟāl, nāviṉaiyum āṇmai yiṉaiyum mārpiṉaiyumuṭaiyōy peruma, ceruvattu uyir pōṟṟalai; iravalar naṭuvaṇ koṭai pōṟṟalai; periyōrp pēṇic ciṟiyōrai yaḷitti; niṉvayiṉ nallicai kaṉavilum piṟar nacai yaṟiyā; aṉaiya aḷapparuṅ kuraiyai; ataṉāl niṉ pukaḻkaḷ ayiraiyiṉ nilaiik kēṭilavāka eṉpatām. iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar “kōtai mārpa, ceruvattu uyir pōṟṟalai; iravalar naṭuvaṇ koṭai pōṟṟalai; periyōraip pēṇic ciṟiyōrai yaḷitti; aṉaiya niṉ kuṇaṅkaḷ aḷappariyai; nī avvā ṟoḻukutalāl, pirinta niṉvayiṉ nallicai iṉik kaṉavilum piṟar naccuta laṟiyā; avvāṟu aṟiyāmaiyiṉ, peruma, niṉ pukaḻ nilaii niṉṉiṭattuk kēṭilavāka eṉa māṟik kūṭṭi viṉaimuṭivu ceyka” eṉṟum, “aṉaiya vaḷapparuṅ kuraiyai yeṉṟatu, ciṟiyōrai yaḷitti eṉṟataṉ piṉṉē niṟka vēṇṭutaliṉ māṟāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu: avaṉ pala kuṇaṅkaḷum oruṅku pukaḻntu vāḻttiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.”
10. puṇṇuṭai yeṟuḻttōḷ
1.	vāṉmaruppiṟ kaḷiṟṟiyāṉai
	māmalaiyiṟ kaṇaṅkoṇṭavar
	eṭutteṟinta viṟaṉmuracam
	kārmaḻaiyiṟ kaṭitumuḻaṅkac
5.	cāntupularnta viyaṉmārpiṟ
	ṟoṭicuṭarvarum valimuṉkaip
	puṇṇuṭai yeṟuḻttōṭ puṭaiyalaṅ kaḻaṟpāl
	piṟakkaṭi yotuṅkāp pūṭkai yoḷvāḷ 
	oṭivi ṟevva retirniṉ ṟuraii
10.	iṭuka tiṟaiyē puravetirn tōṟkeṉa
	ampuṭai valatta ruyarntōr parava
	aṉaiyai yākaṉ māṟē pakaivar
	kālkiḷarn taṉṉa kataḻparip puravik
	kaṭumpari neṭuntēr mīmicai nuṭaṅkukoṭi
15.	pulavarait tōṉṟal yāvatu ciṉappōr
	nilavarai niṟīiya nallicait
	tolaiyāk kaṟpaniṉ ṟemmuṉai yāṉē. 
tuṟai	:	vañcittuṟaip pāṭāṇpāṭṭu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkkum vañcittūkkum
peyar	:	puṇṇuṭai yeṟuḻttōḷ
1-4. vāṉmaruppiṉ ........... muḻaṅka
urai :
vāl maruppiṉ kaḷiṟṟiyāṉai māmalaiyiṉ kaṇaṅ koṇṭu - veḷḷiya maruppiṉaiyuṭaiya pōrkkaḷiṟukaḷ periya malaipōla kūṭit tokku niṟpa; avar eṭutteṟinta viṟal muracam - pakaivar mēṟkoṇṭu muḻaṅkiya veṟṟi muracamāṉatu; kār maḻaiyiṉ kaṭitu muḻaṅka - kār kālattu mukil pōla mikku muḻaṅkavum eṉṟavāṟu.
pōrkkuriya āṇmai nalam ciṟantu niṟkum yāṉaikaḷaik “kaḷiṟṟiyāṉai” yeṉṟār. malaiyiṉ, iṉ : oppup poruṭṭu. avar eṉpatu “oṭuvil tevvar” (9) eṉṟataṉaic cuṭṭi niṟṟaliṉ, cuṭṭu; ceyyuḷātaliṉ muṟpaṭa vantatu. koḷḷa veṉpatu koṇṭeṉat tirintu niṉṟatu. paḻaiyavurai kārarum, “kaṇaṅ koḷḷa veṉat tirikka” eṉṟum, “ava reṉṟatu pakaivarai” yeṉṟum kūṟuvar. eṭutteṟital, tam muṟṟukai tōṉṟa mēṟkoṇṭu muḻakkutal. veṟṟi kuṟittu muḻakkum muracātaliṉ “viṟal muracam” eṉṟār; pali peṟum ciṟappup paṟṟi iṅṅaṉam kūṟiṉā reṉiṉumām. mikutip poruṭṭāya kaṭi yeṉṉu muriccol kaṭitu eṉat tirintu niṉṟatu.
5-9. cāntu ............ niṉṟu
urai :
cāntu pularnta viyaṉ mārpiṉ - pūciya cāntu pularnta akaṉṟa mārpiṉaiyum; toṭi cuṭarvarum valimuṉkai - toṭiyaṇintamaiyāl ataṉ oḷi tikaḻum valiporuntiya muṉkaiyiṉaiyum; puṇṇuṭai eṟuḻttōḷ - āṟāta viḻuppuṇṇaiyuṭaiya valiya tōḷiṉaiyum; puṭaiyalaṅ kaḻaṟkāl - at tōḷiṭattē yaṇinta mālaiyoṭu vīrakaṇṭai yaṇinta kāliṉaiyum; piṟakkaṭi yotuṅkāp pūṭkai - muṉ vaitta kālaip piṉ vaiyāta mēṟkōḷiṉaiyum; oḷvāḷ - oḷḷiya vāṭpaṭaiyiṉaimuṭaiya; oṭivil tevvar etirniṉṟu - vaṇaṅkāta pakaivar muṉṉē añcātu niṉṟu eṉṟavāṟu.
āṭavarkku akaṉṟa mārpu ciṟapput taruvatākaliṉ, ataṉai vitantu, “cāntu pularnta viyaṉ mārpiṉ” eṉṟār. toṭi, tōḷ vaḷai. ivarkaḷ ēnti yaṭum vāṭpaṭaiyai “oḷvāḷ” eṉac ciṟappittaliṉ, ataṟkēṟpa, “valimuṉ kai” yeṉṟār. pala pōrkaḷaic ceytu veṉṟi mēmpaṭṭō reṉṟaṟku, avar uṟṟa puṇṇai vitantu, “puṇṇuṭai yeṟuḻt tōḷ” eṉṟum, puṇṇuṭaittākiyum vali kuṟainta tiṉ ṟeṉṟaṟkup puṇ ṇuṭaittō ḷeṉṉātu, “eṟuḻttō” ḷeṉṟum kūṟiṉār, iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, “puṇṇuṭai yeṟuḻttō ḷeṉṟatu, eppoḻutum poruta puṇṇaṟāta valiya tōḷeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “ic ciṟappāṉē itaṟkup puṇṇuṭai yeṟuḻttōḷ eṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
puṭaiyalaṅkaḻal : ummaittokai. puṭaiyal - mālai. “īkaiyaṅ kaḻaṟkāl irumpaṉam puṭaiyal” (puṟam. 99) eṉṟum, “māyirumpuṭaiyal mākkaḻal puṉaintu” (patiṟ. 37) eṉṟum, “irumpaṉam puṭaiya līkai vāṉkaḻal” (patiṟ. 42) eṉṟum, “irumpaṉam puṭaiyaloṭu vāṉkaḻal civappa” (patiṟ. 57) eṉṟum, “puṭaiyalaṅ kaḻaṟkāl pulli” (akam. 295) eṉṟum ippuṭaiyal kaḻaloṭu piṇaittē kūṟappaṭutaliṉ, itu kaḻalaṇiyum vīrar aṭaiyāḷamākac cūṭum pūmālaiyātal tuṇiyappaṭum. irumpaṉam puṭaiyaleṉat terittu moḻi vatum, “puṭaiyal” eṉa vāḷātu kūṟuvatum ik karuttai valiyuṟuttukiṉṟaṉa. īṇṭut tevvar cūṭiya puṭaiyalait terittu moḻiyāmaiyiṉ, paṉam puṭaiyaleṉak kōṭal poruntāmai yaṟika.
aṭipiṟakkiṭāta mēṟkōḷ vīrarkku iṉṟiyamaiyā maiyiṉ, “piṟakkaṭi yotuṅkāp pūṭkai” eṉṟār. “aṭi yotuṅkip piṟ peyarāp paṭaiyōr” (maturai. 37-8) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟupa. oṭital, maṟaṅkuṉṟip pakaivarkku vaṇaṅkutal; aṟaipōtalumām.
ittakaiya oṭivil tevvar viṟal muracam muḻaṅka muṟṟukai yiṭṭu niṟpavum, avarmuṉ ciṟitum accamilarāy niṉṟu vīṟu pēcum cēramāṉ vīrar maṟanilaiyai “etirniṉṟu” eṉpataṉāl tōṟṟuvikkiṉṟār.
9-17. uraii ........... temmuṉaiyāṉē
urai :
uyarntōr - niṉ tāṉai vīrarākiya uyarntōrkaḷ; ampuṭai valattar - iṭak kaiyil villum valak kaiyil ampu muṭaiyarāy; uraii - at tevvar muṉṉē niṉṟu irumaruṅkum ulāvi; puravu etirntōṟku tiṟai iṭuka - tiṟai celuttit taṉ kōṟkīḻp paṇintu niṟpārkkup pātukāppiṉai vaḻaṅkutaṟku ēṟaṭṭukkoṇṭu niṟkum eṅkaḷ peruñcēralirum poṟaikku nuṅkaḷ tiṟaiyiṉaic celuttuvīrāmiṉ; eṉap parava - eṉṟu niṉkoṭaiyum aḷiyum teṟalum piṟavum pārāṭṭik kūṟa; aṉaiyai yākaṉmāṟē - nīyum avar kūṟum nalamellām uṭaiyai yātaliṉālē; ciṉap pōr - ciṉaṅ koṇṭu ceyyum pōriṉaiyum; nilavarai niṟīiya nallicai - nilavulakattē niṟuvappaṭṭa nalla icaiyiṉaiyum; tolai yāk kaṟpa - kēṭillāta kalviyiṉaiyumuṭaiyāy; niṉ temmuṉaiyāṉ - nī pakaikoṇ ṭāṟṟum pōrmuṉai yākiya; pula varai - taṅkaḷ nilavellaiyiṟṟāṉum; pakaivar - niṉ pakaivaratu; kāl kiḷarntaṉṉa kataḻ parip puravi - kāṟṟuk kiḷarntu ceṉṟāṟ pōlum virainta celaviṉaiyuṭaiya kutiraikaḷ pūṭṭiya; kaṭum pari neṭuntēr mīmicai - kaṭuñ celaviṉaiyuṭaiya neṭiya tēr mītu kaṭṭiya; nuṭaṅku koṭi tōṉṟutal yāvatu - acaikiṉṟa koṭi tōṉṟuvatu eṅṅaṉamākum; iṉi aḵtu evvāṟṟāṉum tōṉṟātu kāṇ eṉṟavāṟu.
pōr vīrarkku vēṇṭum uyarkuṇaṅkaḷellām oruṅkuṭaimai paṟṟi “uyarntōr” eṉṟār. pakaivīraruṭaiya mārpu mutaliyavaṟṟai vitantu kūṟiya āciriyar, avarkaḷai uyarntō reṉṟatu, avarkaṭku ak kūṟiya ciṟappaṉaittum āravāra māttiraiyē eṉa vaṟpuṟuttiyavāṟu. ampuṭai valattareṉavē, villuṭaimai tāṉē peṟappaṭumākaliṉ, atu kūṟārāyiṉār. iṉi ampuṭai valattar eṉṟaṟku, ampiṉā lākiya veṟṟiyaiyuṭaiya reṉṟumām. tevvar muṉ niṉṟu ivvuyarntōr cēraṉuṭaiya talaimaip paṇpu kaḷaiyum āṇmai vaṇmaikaḷaiyum paravik kūṟaluṟṟōr, tam kūṟṟu pakaivar paṭaipparappu muṟṟum kēṭṭal vēṇṭi irumaruṅkum ulavic ceṉṟu uraittār eṉṟaṟku “uraii” yeṉṟum, paṭai tiraṇṭu pōr kuṟittu vantīrāyiṉum tiṟaiyiṭiṉ eṅkaḷ iṟaivaṉ nuṅkaḷaip poṟuttup puravu pūṇpaṉ eṉpār, “iṭuka tiṟaiyē puravetirntōṟkē” eṉṟārkaḷ eṉṟum kūṟiṉar. avvuyarntōr niṉṉaip paṟṟik kūṟiya aṉaittum meyyē yeṉpār, “aṉaiyai yākaṉmāṟē” yeṉṟār. māṟu: mūṉṟām vēṟṟumaip poruṭṭu.
pakaivaratu kutiraiyiṉ tiṟam kūṟuvār, “kālkiḷarn taṉṉa kaṭumparip puravi” yeṉṟum, avaṟṟaip pūṭṭum tērum ittakaiya teṉṟaṟkuk “kaṭumpari neṭuntēr” eṉṟum, “kālkiḷarn taṉṉa vēḻam” (muruku.) eṉṟum cāṉṟōr virainta naṭaikkuk kāṟṟai uvamam kūṟuvatu kāṇka. ciṟappummai vikārattāl tokkatu. niṉ nallicai nilavarai muḻutum paravi nilaipeṟutaliṉ, pakaivaratu koṭi nuṭaṅkutaṟkum iṭaṉillai eṉpatu kūṟiyavāṟu. nallicai niṟuvutaṟkēṟṟa kalviyum mika vuṭaiyāy eṉpār, “tolaiyāk kaṟpa” eṉṟār.
iṉi, paḻaiyavuraikārar, “puravetirntōṟkeṉṟatu koṭai yēṟṟirukkiṉṟa avaṉukkeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “koṭi tōṉṟal eṉṟataṉai eḻuvāyum payaṉilaiyumākak koḷka” eṉṟum, “niṉ temmuṉaip pulavaraiyāṉ eṉa māṟik kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu: kaḷiṟṟiyāṉai kaṇaṅkoḷḷa, avar eṟinta muracam muḻaṅkavum, mārpiṉaiyum, muṉ kaiyiṉaiyum tōḷiṉaiyum, puṭaiyalaiyum, kaḻaṟkālaiyum, pūṭkai yiṉaiyum, vāḷiṉaiyumuṭaiya oṭivil tevvar etirniṉṟu, uyarntōr, ampuṭaiya valattarāy uraii puravetirn tōṟku iṭuka tiṟaiyē yeṉap parava, aṉaiyai yākaṉmāṟē, ciṉappōrum nallicaiyum kaṟpiṉaiyu muṭaiyāy, niṉ temmuṉaiyākiya pulavaraiyil, pakaivar kataḻparip puravik kaṭuntēr mīmicai neṭuṅkoṭi tōṉṟal yāvatu eṉpatām. iṉip paḻaiya vuraikārar, “tolaiyāk kaṟpa, niṉ vīrarākiya uyarntōr niṉ tevvarākiya avaruṭaiya kaḷiṟṟiyāṉai malaiyiṟ kaṇaṅ koḷḷā niṟka, muracam kaṭitu muḻaṅkāniṟka, avaiyiṟṟai oṉṟum matiyātē niṉṉoṭu oṭivil tevva rākiya avar etirniṉṟu peyarā ippura vetirntōṉukkut tiṟaiyai yiṭuka veṉac colli niṉṉaip paravumpaṭi nī ataṟkēṟṟa taṉmaiyai yuṭaiyaiyāṉa paṭiyālē niṉ temmuṉaip pulavellaiyil niṉ pakaivar tērmicaik koṭipōraik kuṟittut tōṉṟal yātu eṉakkūṭṭi viṉaimuṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ koṭaic ciṟappoṭu paṭuttu veṉṟic ciṟappuk kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.
“temmuṉaip pulavaraip pakaivarkoṭi tōṉṟal yāvatu eṉa etirūṉṟuvāriṉmai tōṉṟak kūṟiya vataṉāl vañcit tuṟaippāṭāṇāyiṟṟu.”
“muṉṉar āṟaṭiyum vañciyaṭiyāy vantamaiyāṉē vañcittūkku māyiṟṟu.”
iruvakait tūkkum viravivantatāyiṉum āciriya naṭaiyē peṟṟu iṉiya ōcaikoṇṭu varutaliṉ oḻuku vaṇṇa māyiṟṟu; “oḻukuvaṇṇam ōcaiyi ṉoḻukum” (tol. cey. 224) eṉṟā rākaliṉ.

5.	arumiḷaik kallakat tainteyi leṟintu
	potti yāṇṭa peruñ cōḻaṉaiyum
	vittai yāṇṭa viḷampaḻaiyaṉ māṟaṉaiyum
	vaitta vañciṉam vāyppa veṉṟu
	vañci mūtūrt tantu piṟarkkutavi
10.	mantira marapiṟ ṟeyvam pēṇi
	meyyū ramaicciyaṉ maiyūr kiḻāṉaip
	puraiyaṟu kēḷvip purōcu mayakki
	aruntiṟaṉ marapiṟ peruñcatuk kamarnta
	ventiṟaṟ pūtarait tantiva ṇiṟīi
15.	āynta marapiṟ cānti vēṭṭu
	maṉṉuyir kātta maṟuvil ceṅkōl
	iṉṉicai muraci ṉiḷañcēra lirum poṟaiyaip
peruṅkuṉṟūr kiḻār pāṭiṉār pattuppāṭṭu. avai tām: niḻal viṭu kaṭṭi, viṉainavil yāṉai, paḵṟōṟṟoḻuti, toḻiṉavil yāṉai, nāṭukāṇ neṭuvarai, ventiṟaṟ ṟaṭakkai, veṇṭalaic cempuṉal, kalkāl kavaṇai, tuvarāk kūntal, valikeḻu taṭakkai. ivaipāṭṭiṉ patikam.
pāṭippeṟṟa paricil : maruḷillārkku maruḷak koṭukka veṉṟu uvakaiyiṉ muppattīrāyiram kāṇaṅ koṭuttu, avar aṟiyāmai ūrum maṉaiyum vaḷamikap paṭaittu, ērum iṉpamum iyalvarap parappi, eṇṇaṟkākā aruṅkala veṟukkaiyoṭu, paṉṉūṟāyiram pāṟpaṭa vakuttuk kāppu maṟam tāṉviṭṭāṉ ak kō.
kuṭak kō iḷañcēra lirumpoṟai patiṉāṟāṇṭu vīṟṟiruntāṉ.
1. niḻalviṭu kaṭṭi
1.	ulakam purakku murukeḻu ciṟappiṉ
	vaṇṇak karuviya vaḷaṅkeḻu kamañcūl
	akaliru vicumpi ṉatirciṉañ ciṟantu
	kaṭuñcilai kaḻaṟi vicumpaṭaiyū nivantu
5.	kālai yicaikkum poḻutoṭu pulampukoḷak
	kaḷiṟupāyn tiyalak kaṭumā tāṅka
	oḷiṟukoṭi nuṭaṅkat tērtirintu koṭpa
	aracupuṟat tiṟappiṉu matirvilar tirintu
	vāyil koḷḷā maintiṉar vayavar
10.	māyiruṅ kaṅkulum viḻuttoṭi cuṭarvarat
	tōḷpiṇi mīkaiyar pukalciṟantu nāḷum
	muṭital vēṭkaiyar neṭiya moḻiyūuk
	keṭāa nallicait taṅkuṭi niṟumār
	iṭāa vēṇi viyalaṟaik koṭpa
15.	nāṭaṭip paṭuttaliṟ koḷḷai māṟṟi
	aḻalviṉai yamainta niḻalviṭu kaṭṭi
	kaṭṭaḷai valippa niṉtāṉai yutavi
	vēṟupulat tiṟutta velpō raṇṇal
	muḻavi ṉamainta perumpaḻa micaintu
20.	cāṟayarn taṉṉa kāraṇi yāṇart
	tūmpakam paḻuṉiya tīmpiḻi māntik
	kāntaḷaṅ kaṇṇic ceḻuṅkuṭic celvar
	kalimakiḻ mēvala riravalark kīyum
	curumpār cōlaip perumpeyark kollip
25.	peruvāy malaroṭu pacumpiṭi makiḻntu
	miṉṉumiḻn taṉṉa cuṭariḻai yāyattut
	taṉṉiṟaṅ karanta vaṇṭupaṭu katuppiṉ
	oṭuṅkī rōti yoṇṇuta laṇikoḷak
	koṭuṅkuḻaik kamartta nōkki yaivarap
30.	peruntakaik kamarnta meṉcoṟ ṟirumukattu
	māṇiḻai yarivai kāṇiya vorunāṭ
	pūṇka māḷaniṉ puravi neṭuntēr
	muṉaikai viṭṭu muṉṉilaic cellātu
	tūvetirntu peṟāat tāviṉ maḷḷaroṭu
35.	toṉmaruṅ kaṟutta lañciyaraṇ koṇṭu
	tuñcā vēntarun tuñcuka
	viruntu māka niṉperun tōṭkē.
tuṟai	:	mullai

tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	niḻalviṭu kaṭṭi
1-5. ulakam ........... pulampukoḷa
urai :
ulakam purakkum - ulakattiluḷḷa uyirkaḷaip pātukāt talaic ceyyum; urukeḻu ciṟappiṉ - uṭkutalaic ceyyum ciṟappiṉaiyum; vaṇṇak karuviya - kariya niṟattaiyumuṭaiya palavāyt tokuti koṇṭaṉavākiya; vaḷaṅkeḻu kamañcūl - vaḷamporuntiya niṟainta nīraiyuṭaiya maḻaimēkaṅkaḷ; akal iru vicumpiṉ - akaṉṟa kariya vāṉattiṉkaṇ; atir ciṉam ciṟantu - ellāp poruḷum atirumpaṭi miṉṉik kumuṟi; kaṭuñ cilaiyoṭu kaḻaṟi - mikka muḻakkattōṭu iṭittu; vicumpu aṭaiyū nivantu - vāṉa muḻutum parantuyarntu; kālai yicaikkum poḻutoṭu - kārkālattait terivikkum paruvattāl; pulampu koḷa - uyirkaḷ varutta meyta eṉṟavāṟu.
ulakam purakkum vaḷaṅkeḻu kamañcūl eṉṟum, ciṟap piṉaiyum vaṇṇattiṉaiyumuṭaiyavāyk karuviyavākiya kamañcūl eṉṟum iyaiyum. maḻaiyiṉṟip poyppiṉ ulakattuḷ paciniṉṟu uṭaṟṟu mātaliṉ, “ulakam purakkum kamañcūl” eṉṟum, tuppārkkut tuppāya tuppākkit tarutaliṉ “vaḷaṅkeḻu kamañcūl” eṉṟum, iṭi miṉṉal mutaliyavaṟṟāl uyirkaṭku accattai viḷaittaliṉ, “urukeḻu ciṟappiṉ kamañcūl” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. iru vicumpu mika akaṉṟa tāyiṉum ataṉiṭamuḻutum atirak kumuṟutal paṟṟi, “akaliru vicumpiṉ atirciṉam ciṟantu” eṉṟār. kamañcūl, kamañ cūlaiyuṭaiya mēkattukkāyiṟṟu. kamam, niṟaivu. “kārkōḷ mukanta kamañcūl māmaḻai” (muruku. 7) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka. atir ciṉam, mukiṟ kūṭṭattiṉ kumuṟalaiyum, kaṭuñcilai pēriṭiyiṉaiyum kuṟittu niṉṟaṉa. maḻai mikkup peytalāl māvum puḷḷum kuḷirāl oṭuṅki varuntutaliṉ, “pulampu koḷa” eṉṟār.
iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, “kamañcūl, mēkaṅka” ḷeṉṟum, “niṟainta cūluṭaimaiyiṉ mēkaṅkaḷ kamañcūl eṉappaṭṭaṉa” eṉṟum, “cilaiyoṭu kaḻaṟiyeṉa oṭu virikka” eṉṟum, “cilai, muḻaṅkutal; kaḻaṟal, iṭittal” eṉṟum, “nivantu vicumpaṭaiyū veṉa māṟik kūṭṭuka” eṉṟum, “vicumpaṭaital malaiyilē paṭintavai eḻuntu vicumpai yaṭaital” eṉṟum, “kālai yicaikkum poḻutoṭu pulampu koḷa veṉṟatu, mēkaṅkaḷ kār kālattai aṟivikkiṉṟa paruvattāṉē varuttam koḷḷāniṟka veṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
6-14. kaḷiṟu ........... koṭpa
urai :
kaḷiṟu pāyntu iyala - kaḷiṟukaḷ pācaṟai yellaiyiṟ parantu iyaṅka; kaṭumā tāṅka - viraintu cellum kutiraikaḷ vīrarkaḷaic cumantu avar kuṟippuvaḻic cella; oḷiṟu koṭi nuṭaṅkat tēr tirintukoṭpa - viḷaṅkukiṉṟa koṭikaḷ acaiyat tērkaḷ nāṟṟicaiyum cuḻaṉṟu tiriya; aracu puṟattu iṟuppiṉum - pakaiyaracar tam nakarppuṟattē muṟṟukai yiṭṭut taṅkiṉum; atirvilar - ciṟitum naṭukkamilarāy; vāyil koḷḷā maintiṉar vayavar - tamakkuriya iṭaṅkaṭkuk kāval koḷḷāta valimaiyiṉai yuṭaiyarākiya vīrar; māyiruṅ kaṅkulum - periya iruḷ niṟainta irāk kālattum; viḻut toṭi cuṭarvara - tam tōḷilaṇinta vīravaḷai oḷitikaḻa;  tōḷ piṇi mīkaiyar - tōḷiṭattē piṇikkappaṭṭa mīkai yiṉaiyuṭaiyarāy; nāḷum muṭital vēṭkaiyar - pōriṟ puṇpaṭṭu vīḻtalai virumpum vēṭkaiyarāy, pukal ciṟantu - pōr viruppam mikku; neṭiya moḻiyūu - vañciṉam kūṟi avvañciṉam tappāmal; tam kuṭi keṭāa nallicai niṟumār - tām piṟanta kuṭikkuk keṭāta nalla pukaḻai nilainiṟuttutaṟku; iṭāa ēṇi viyal aṟaik koṭpa - aḷaviṭappaṭāta ellaiyāl akaṉṟa pācaṟaikkaṇṇē cuḻaṉṟu tiriya eṉṟavāṟu.
pāytal - parattal. paruvuṭampiṉavātaliṉ, kaḷiṟukaḷiṉ iyakkattaip “pāyntiyala” veṉṟār. kaṭumā eṉpuḻik kaṭumai viraivu kuṟittu niṉṟatu. tāṅka veṉṟataṉāl, vīrarkaḷaic cumattal peṟṟām. vāyil, kāval. mikka valiyuṭaiyarāyiṉum pakaiyaracar puṟattiṟuttavaḻi, matiṟ kāvalkoḷḷātoḻivā reṉpatu tōṉṟa, “vāyil koḷḷā maintiṉar” eṉṟār. vāyil koḷḷāmaikkētu maintuṭaimai yeṉṟārāyiṉum, ataṉaip pulappaṭukkum naṭukkamiṉmaiyai “atirvilar” eṉa eṭuttōtiṉār. irāk kālattē pōr nikaḻtaliṉmaiyiṉ, “māyiruṅ kaṅkulum” eṉṟār. mīkai, tōḷmēlaṇiyum caṭṭai. caṭṭaiyiṉ kai, tōḷai mūṭi ataṉmēlē uyarntu tōṉṟaliṉ mīkai yeṉappaṭṭatu. iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, “vāyilkoḷḷā maintiṉa reṉṟatu tamakkuk kāvalaṭaitta, iṭaṅkaḷaic ceṉṟu kaikkoḷḷā valiyiṉai yuṭaiyava reṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “vāyil īṇṭu iṭam” eṉṟum, “tōḷ piṇi mīkaiya reṉṟatu kuḷirālē tōḷaip piṇitta attōḷ mītu uḷavākiya kaikaḷaiyuṭaiya reṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟuṅ kūṟuvar.
pōrilē puṇpaṭṭu vīḻtaliṉṟi vaṟitē mūttu nōyuṟṟuc cātalaik kīḻmaiyākak karuti, “nōṟṟōr maṉṟa tāmē kūṟṟam, kōḷuṟa viḷiyār piṟarkoḷa viḷintōr” (akam. 61) eṉa mēṟ cēṟal, paṇṭaic cāṉṟōr marapātaliṉ, “pukal ciṟantu nāḷum muṭital vēṭkaiya” reṉṟār. vēṭkai mikutiyāl pōril viruppam ciṟakkumātaliṉ, vēṭkaiyar pukal ciṟanteṉa iyaikkappaṭṭatu. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “muṭital vēṭkaiya reṉṟatu tām eṭuttuk koṇṭa pōr muṭitalilē vēṭkai yuṭaiyā reṉṟavā” ṟeṉpar.
neṭiya moḻitalāvatu, “talaittā ṇeṭumoḻi taṉ ṉoṭu puṇarttal” (tol. po. puṟam. 5). “neṭiya moḻitalum kaṭiya vūrtalum celvamaṉṟu” (naṟ. 210) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟutal kāṇka. iṉi, in neṭumoḻiyai “mārāyam peṟṟa neṭumoḻi” (tol. puṟat. 8) yākak kōṭalumoṉṟu. iṭāa ēṇi yeṉṟatu ellaikku veḷippaṭai. aṟai, pācaṟai. “iṭāa ēṇi yiyalaṟai” (patiṟ. 24) eṉa varutal kāṇka.
kaḷiṟu iyala, mātāṅka, tēr tirintu koṭpa, vayavar mīkaiyarāy, vēṭkaiyarāy, niṟumār, viyalaṟaik koṭpa eṉa iyaikka.
15-18. nāṭaṭippaṭuttaliṟ ......... aṇṇal
urai :
nāṭu aṭippaṭuttaliṉ - pakaivar nāṭṭai veṉṟu aṭippaṭuttiyataṉāl;  koḷḷai māṟṟi - annāṭṭil mēlum koḷḷattakum poruḷaik koḷḷā toḻittu; aḻalviṉai yamainta niḻalviṭu kaṭṭi - koṇṭavaṟṟai neruppiliṭṭurukki yataṉāl ōṭutal illāta oḷiviṭukiṉṟa poṟkaṭṭikaḷai; kaṭṭaḷai valippa - vīrar takutikaḷaic cāṉṟōr vaṟpuṟut turaippatāl; niṉ tāṉai utavi - avvāṟē uṉ tāṉai vīrarkku vaḻaṅki; vēṟu pulattiṟutta velpōr aṇṇal - vēṟṟu nāṭukaḷil taṅkiya vellu kiṉṟa pōraiyuṭaiya aṇṇalē eṉṟavāṟu.
pakaivar nāṭṭai aṭippaṭuttaṟku muṉpu, ataṉuṭpukku eriparanteṭuttuc cūṟaiyāṭik koṇṭa koḷḷaiyai, aṭippaṭuttiya piṉpu peṟuvatiṉmaiyiṉ, “nāṭaṭip paṭuttaliṉ koḷḷai māṟṟi” yeṉṟum, koṇṭa koḷḷai palvēṟu vakaip poṟkalaṉkaḷātalāl, avaṟṟai ōriṉa mākkutaṟkākap poṭitturukkip poṟkaṭṭikaḷāka māṟṟiṉamai tōṉṟa, “aḻalviṉai yamainta niḻalviṭu kaṭṭi” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. paḻaiyavuraikārarum, “nāṭaṭip paṭuttaliṟ koḷḷai māṟṟi” yeṉṟatu, nāṭṭai yaṭippaṭuttiṉapaṭiyālē aṭippaṭuttum kālattu uṇṭāyc ceṉṟa koḷḷaiyai māṟṟi yeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “aḻalviṉai yamaital, ōṭṭaṟutal; ivvaṭaic ciṟappāṉē yitaṟku niḻalviṭu kaṭṭiyeṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar. niḻal, oḷi.
vīrarkkuc ciṟappuc ceyyumiṭattu avaravar takutiyum varicaiyum tērntu ataṟkut takkavāṟu ceyvatu āṭcimuṟai yātaliṉ, “kaṭṭaḷai valippa” eṉṟār, “kaṭṭaḷai valittaleṉpatu iṉṉār iṉṉataṉaip peṟuka eṉṟu taraṅkaḷai niccayittal” eṉpatu paḻaiyavurai. tāṉai yeṉpuḻi nāṉkaṉurupu virikka. vēṟu pulattiṟuttavaḻi vēntaṉ ceyvaṉa ivai yeṉkiṉṟā rātaliṉ, “vēṟu pulattiṟutta velpō raṇṇal” eṉṟuraikkiṉṟār.
19-23. muḻaviṉ .......... īyum
urai :
kāntaḷaṅkaṇṇic ceḻuṅkuṭic celvar - kāntaṭ pūvāl toṭutta kaṇṇi cūṭiya ceḻitta kuṭiyiṉaiyuṭaiya celva makkaḷ; muḻaviṉ amainta perumpaḻam micaintu - muḻavu pōṉṟamainta periya palāppaḻattai yuṇṭu; cāṟayarn taṉṉa - viḻāk koṇṭāṭiṉāṟpōla; yāṇar kār aṇi tūmpakam paḻuṉiya tīmpiḻi mānti - putumaiyiṉaiyuṭaiya kariya aḻakiya mūṅkiṟ kuḻāyiṭattē peytu mutirvitta iṉiya kaḷḷai yarunti; kali makiḻ mēvalar - āravārattaiyuṭaiya makiḻcciyai virumpi; iravalarkku īyum - irappōrkku vēṇṭuvaṉavaṟṟai yītalaic ceyyum kolli nāṭṭiluḷḷa eṉṟavāṟu.
kollimalaiyaic cūḻnta nāṭṭaik kollikkūṟṟa meṉpar. annāṭṭavar kuṟiñci nilattu makkaḷātaliṉ, annāṭṭuc celvar kāntaṭkaṇṇi cūṭutalai vitantu, “kāntaḷaṅ kaṇṇic ceḻuṅkuṭic celvar” eṉṟār. aṅkē, palāppaḻam mikutiyum kiṭaippatu ik kālattum uṇmai. “kalaiyuṇak kiḻitta muḻavumaruḷ perumpaḻam” (puṟam. 236) eṉpavākaliṉ, īṇṭum palāppaḻam, “muḻaviṉamainta perum paḻa” meṉappaṭṭatu. viḻākkālattuc cuṟṟamum piṟarum cūḻavuṇṭalpōla ēṉaikkālattum uṇṭu makiḻtalaic “cāṟayarntaṉṉa tīmpiḻi mānti” eṉṟataṉālum, iṉiya kaḷḷai mūṅkiṟ kuḻāyiṭattē peytu puḷippu mutirvikkum iyalpai, “nīṭamai viḷainta tēkkaṭ ṭēṟal” (muruku. 195) eṉpataṉālu maṟika. iravalarkkīyum kolliyeṉa muṭikka. paḻaiyavurai kārarum, “cāṟayarn taṉṉa tīmpiḻiyeṉa muṭittu viḻāk koṇṭāṭiṉā lotta iṉiya matuveṉa vuraikka” eṉṟum, “kāraṇi yāṇart tūmpu eṉṟatu karumaiyaip poruntiṉa aḻakiya mūṅkiṟ kuḻāy eṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
24-32. curumpu ............ neṭuntēr
urai :
curumpār cōlaip perum peyark kolli - vaṇṭukaḷ poruntiya cōlai cūḻnta periya peyaraiyuṭaiya kolli malaiyil uṇṭākiya; peruvāy malaroṭu pacumpiṭi makiḻntu - iruvāṭcip pūkkaḷuṭaṉ paccilaiyait toṭut taṇintu; miṉ umiḻntaṉṉa cuṭariḻai yāyattu - miṉṉalai umiḻntāṟ pōṉṟa oḷitikaḻum aṇikaḷaiyuṭaiya āyamakaḷir puṭaicūḻa vuḷḷa; taṉ niṟaṅ karanta vaṇṭupaṭu katuppiṉ - taṉ niṟam maṟaiyumpaṭiyāṉa vaṇṭu moykkum kūntalum; oṭuṅkīrōti yoṇṇutal - muṉ mayiriṉ curuḷ tavaḻum oḷi poruntiya neṟṟiyum; aṇikoḷa - muṟaiyē pūvālum oḷiyālum aḻakumikumāṟu; koṭuṅkuḻaik kamartta nōkkiṉ - vaḷainta kuḻaiyoṭu poruta pārvaiyiṉaiyum; peruntakaikku nayavara amarnta meṉcol - taṉ peruṅkuṇaṅ kaṭku ēṟpa amainta melliya colliṉaiyum; tirumukattu māṇiḻai yarivai - aḻakiya mukattaiyum māṭcimaippaṭṭa aṇikalaṉkaḷaiyu muṭaiya arivaiyākiya niṉ tēviyai; kāṇiya - kāṇpataṟkāka; orunāḷ - orunāḷēṉum; niṉ puravi neṭuntēr pūṇka - niṉṉuṭaiya kutirai pūṭṭiya tēr ēṟuvāyāka eṉṟavāṟu.
peruvāy malar, iruvāṭcippū. itaṉai iruḷvāci yeṉṟum naḷḷiruṇāṟi yeṉṟuṅ kūṟupa. “naranta nāka naḷḷiru ṇāṟi” eṉṟu kuṟiñcippāṭṭuk kūṟukiṉṟatu. pacumpiṭi, paccilaippū; itaṉai ik kālattār maṉō rañcitam eṉpar ; “pacumpiṭi vakuḷam palliṇark kāyā” (kuṟiñ. 70) eṉa varutal kāṇka. “iruvāṭci mutaliyavaṟṟaiyum cuṭariḻaiyiṉaiyu muṭaiya āyamakaḷir eṉac ciṟappittavar, aracamātēvi attakaiya pū voṉṟum aṇintu koḷḷātu pirivut tuyaruṟṟiruntamai tōṉṟa, oṉṟum kūṟārāyiṉāreṉa vuṇarka. makiḻnteṉpataṟku, “virumpic cūṭiyavā” ṟeṉṟum, miṉṉumiḻntaṉṉa cuṭariḻai yeṉṟatu, mēkam miṉkaḷai umiḻntāṟ pōṉṟa cuṭarkaḷaiyuṭaiya iḻaiyeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum paḻaiyavuraikārar kūṟuvar.
talaimayiriṉ karumai vaṇṭiṉam mikkuppaṭutalāl teriyātāyiṟ ṟeṉṟaṟku, “taṉṉiṟam karanta vaṇṭupaṭu katuppiṉ” eṉṟum, oḷi tikaḻum neṟṟiyiṭattē curuṇṭu tavaḻtaliṉ, muṉmayirai “oṭuṅ kīrōti” yeṉṟum, aracaṉ eytit taṉṉait talaikkūṭiya vaḻi, kūntal pūvaṇintu ciṟattalum nutal nalloḷikoṇṭu tikaḻtalum orutalai yātal paṟṟi, “taṉṉiṟam karanta vaṇṭupaṭu katuppiṉ oṭuṅkīrōti yoṇṇuta laṇikoḷa” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār.
kuḻaiyoṭu porum neṭuṅkaṇ ṇeṉṟaṟku, “koṭuṅ kuḻaikkamartta nōkkiṉ” eṉṟum, periyāratu peruntakaimai avar pēcum iṉcollāl viḷaṅkutalāl, “peruntakaikku nayavara amarnta meṉcol” eṉṟum, maṅkala nāṇaṉṟip piṟitaṇi pēṇāmaiyiṉ ataṉai “māṇiḻai” yeṉṟum pārāṭṭiṉār. aṇikoḷa eṉpataik katuppiṉ eṉpata ṉōṭum iyaikka; iṉ ; avvaḻikkaṇ vanta cāriyai. nayavara amarnta eṉa iyaittukkoḷka. nāḷum pōr vēṭṭeḻum iyalpiṉaṉātaliṉ, “arivai kāṇiya orunāḷ pūṇka māḷa niṉpuravi neṭuntēr,” eṉṟār. eṉavē, kāmaviṉpattiṉum pōriṭai yuṇṭākum veṟṟi yiṉpamē iccēramāṉukkup periteṉṟārāyiṟṟu.
33-37. muṉaikai ......... tōṭkē
urai :
muṉṉilai muṉaikai viṭṭu - niṉ muṉṉē niṉṟu porum pōraik kaiviṭṭu; cellātu - piṟakkiṭ ṭōṭātu; tū etirntu - niṉ valiyōṭu porutu; peṟāat tāvil maḷḷaroṭu - veṟṟi yeyta māṭṭāmaiyāl valiyillāta vīraruṭaṉē; toṉmaruṅku aṟuttal añci - toṉṟutoṭṭu varum tam kuṭi vērōṭu keṭutaṟku añci; tuñcā vēntarum - kaṇṇuṟaṅkāta niṉ pakaivēntar tāmum ; araṇ koṇṭu tuñcuka - oru nāḷaikku nī pōrai niṟutti niṉ arivaiyaik kāṇac cēṟalāl; tam araṇai yaṭaintu ciṟitu kaṇṇuṟaṅku varāka; niṉ peruntōṭku viruntumāka - niṉṉuṭaiya periya tōḷkaṭku viruntākavum amaika eṉṟavāṟu.
muṉai, pōr. niṉ tōḷvaliyum paṭaivaliyum kāṭci māttiraiyāṉē pakaivarkku veṟṟiyillai yeṉpatai yaṟivippaṉavākavum, avarkaḷ aṟiyāmal etirntaḻintaṉa reṉpār, “muṉaikai viṭṭu muṉṉilaic cellātu, tūvetirntu peṟā at tāvil maḷḷar” eṉṟār. peṟāa: kāraṇapporuṭṭu. peṟutaṟkuriya ceyappaṭuporuḷ varuvikkap paṭṭatu. niṉ vali yaṟintu paṇintu nillāmaiyāl avar vērōṭu keṭutal orutalai yātalai yuṇarntamai tōṉṟa, “toṉmaruṅkaṟuttal añci” yeṉṟār. iṉip paḻaiyavurai kārar, “muṉaikai viṭṭu muṉṉilaic cellātu tuñcā eṉa muṭittu, niṉṉōṭu pōr ceykaiyaik kaiviṭṭu niṉ muṉṉē vantu vaḻipaṭṭu niṟṟalaic ceyyamāṭṭāmai yāl tuñcātaveṉa vuraikka” eṉṟum, “tūvetirntu peṟāat tāvil maḷḷaroṭu eṉṟatu, muṉpu niṉ valiyōṭu etirttup piṉ etirkkap peṟāta valiyillāta maḷḷaroṭu eṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum uraippar.
itukāṟuṅ kūṟiyatu kamañcūl ciṉañ ciṟantu vicumpaṭaiyū nivantu kālai yicaikkum poḻutoṭu pulampukoḷa, akkālattē, kaḷiṟu iyaṅka, mā taṅka, tēr tirintu koṭpa, vayavar viyalaṟaik koṭpa, nāṭaṭippaṭuttaliṉ koḷḷai māṟṟi, niḻalviṭu kaṭṭiyait tāṉaikkutavi, vēṟupulat tiṟutta velpō raṇṇal, ceḻuṅkuṭic celvar tīmpiḻi mānti, iravalarkku vēṇṭuvaṉa īyum kollip, peruvāy malaroṭu pacumpiṭi makiḻntaṇiyum āyattār cūḻa vuṟaiyum arivai katuppum nutalum aṇikoḷa orunāṭ kāṇiya, niṉpuravi neṭuntēr pūṇka; ataṉāl, toṉmaruṅ kaṟut talañcit tuñcā vēntarum maḷḷaruṭaṉē araṇkoṇṭu tuñcuka; niṉ peruntōṭku viruntumāka eṉa iyaittu muṭittavāṟu.
paḻaiyavuraikārar, “aṇṇal, niṉ arivai kāṇiya niṉtēr orunāṭ puravi pūṇpatāka vēṇṭum; atutāṉ niṉ arivaikkē yuṭalāka vēṇṭuvatillai; ataṉāṉē tuñcā vēntarum tuñcuvārkaḷāka vēṇṭum; atutāṉ niṉ peruntōṭku viruntumāka vēṇṭum; ivvāṟu iraṇṭoru kāriyamāka itaṉaic ceyka eṉa viṉaimuṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu: kāma vēṭkaiyiṟ cellāta avaṉ veṉṟi vēṭkaic ciṟappuk kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.”
“iḵtu avaṉarivai kaṟpu mullaiyaippaṟṟi vantamaiyāl tuṟai mullaiyāyiṟṟu.”
2. viṉai navil yāṉai
1.	pakaiperu maiyiṟ ṟeyvañ ceppa
	āriṟai yañcā veruvaru kaṭṭūrp
	palkoṭi nuṭaṅku muṉpiṟ ceṟunar
	celcaman tolaitta viṉainavil yāṉai
5.	kaṭāam vārntu kaṭuñciṉam potti
	vaṇṭupaṭu ceṉṉiya piṭipuṇarn tiyala
	maṟavar maṟala māppaṭai yuṟuppat
	tērkoṭi nuṭaṅkat tōlpuṭai yārppak
	kāṭukai kāyttiya nīṭunā ḷirukkai
10.	iṉṉa vaikal paṉṉā ḷāka
	pāṭik kāṇku vanticiṟ peruma          
	pāṭunar, koḷakkoḷak kuṟaiyāc celvattuc ceṟṟōr
	kolakkolak kuṟaiyāt tāṉaic cāṉṟōr
	vaṇmaiyuñ cemmaiyuñ cālpu maṟaṉum
15.	pukaṉṟupukaḻn tacaiyā nallicai
	nilantaru tiruvi ṉeṭiyōy niṉṉē.
tuṟai	:	kāṭci vāḻttu
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇamum coṟcīr vaṇṇamum.
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	viṉai navil yāṉai
1-10. pakai ........ paṉṉāḷāka
urai :
pakai perumaiyiṉ - niṉatu pakaimai peritātalāl; teyvam ceppa - pakaivar tamakkup pātukāvalākat teyvattai vaḻipaṭa;  ār iṟai añcā veruvaru kaṭṭūr - iṉitiruttaṟ karitākiyum vīrarkku accam payavāta pakaivarkku accattait tarukiṉṟa pācaṟaiyilē; palkoṭi nuṭaṅku muṉpiṟ ceṟunar - palvakaik koṭikaḷ acaikiṉṟa valiyiṉaiyumuṭaiya pakaivaratu; cel camam tolaitta - mikkuc ceṉṟu porum pōrkaḷai yaḻitta; viṉainavil yāṉai - pōrttoḻililē naṉku payiṟci peṟṟuḷḷa yāṉaikaḷ; kaṭāam vārntu - matam poḻintu; kaṭuñciṉam potti - mikka ciṉam koṇṭu; vaṇṭupaṭu ceṉṉiya - matanīriṉ poruṭṭu vaṇṭu moykkun talaiyiṉai yuṭaiyavāy; piṭi puṇarntu iyala - mataveṟi teḷiyumāṟṟāl piṭiyāṉaikaḷaip puṇarttap puṇarntum teḷiyātu tiriya; maṟavar maṟala - vīrar pōr viraiya nikaḻāmaiyiṉ pōr veṟikoṇṭu tiriya; mā paṭai uṟuppa - kutiraikaḷ porutal vēṇṭik kalaṉai mutaliya paṭai yaṇiyappeṟṟu niṟpa; tēr koṭi nuṭaṅka - tērkaḷ paṇṇap peṟṟuk koṭi yacaiya viḷaṅka; tōl puṭai yārppa - kiṭukup paṭaikaḷ orupuṟattē āravārikka;  kāṭukai kāyttiya - kāṭṭiluḷḷa viṟakukaḷai veṭṭik kuḷir kāyntaḻitta; nīṭu nāḷ irukkai - neṭunāḷkaḷ iruttalai yuṭaiya; iṉṉa vaikal paṉṉāḷāka - it taṉmaiyāṉa nāḷkaḷ palavākak kaḻintataṉālē eṉṟavāṟu.
tam valiyum paṭai tuṇai mutaliyavaṟṟiṉ valiyum cēravaittu nōkkiyapōtum niṉvali peritātal kaṇṭu, añci, tamakku veṟṟi varutal vēṇṭit tevvar teyvattaip paravukiṉṟaṉa reṉpār, “pakai perumaiyiṉ teyvam ceppa” eṉṟār. eṉavē, tammāl ceytukoḷḷavēṇṭiya valimuṟṟum ceytukoṇṭā rāyiṉum, cēraṉatu pakaimai peritātaṟ kañcit tammiṉ mēmpaṭṭa teyvattait tuṇai vēṇṭu
varāyiṉa reṉpatām.
eppōtum paṭaiyēntiya vaṇṇamāyp pakaivarai etirnōkki yiruttaliṉ, pācaṟai vīrarkku ariya irukkai yātaliṉ, “āriṟai” yeṉṟum, aṟṟāyiṉum avaruḷḷattē accam nilavāmaiyiṉ, “añcā” eṉṟum, pakaivarkku accattaip payattaliṉ, “veruvaru kaṭṭūr” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. āriṟai yañcāk kaṭṭūr, veruvaru kaṭṭūr eṉa iyaiyum. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “āriṟai yañcāk kaṭṭūreṉṟatu vīrar aritāka iṟuttalai yañcāta pācaṟai yeṉṟavā” ṟeṉpar. vēṟṟu nāṭṭiṭattē putitāka amaikkap peṟutaliṉ, pācaṟaiyaik “kaṭṭūr” eṉpa; “vēṟu pulattiṟutta kaṭṭūr” (patiṟ. 68) eṉṟu piṟarum kūṟiṉamai kāṇka.
tēr, yāṉai mutaliyavai tāṅkivarum koṭikaḷ pala vātaliṉ “palkoṭi nuṭaṅkum” eṉṟum, ivaṟṟai yuyarttit tam valiyāṟ cerukkivarum pakaivaratu pōrpalavum neṟiyaṟintu tākki veṟṟi koṇṭa yāṉai yeṉṟaṟku, “ceṟunar celcaman tolaitta viṉai navil yāṉai” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. ic ciṟappāl ip pāṭṭiṟku viṉainavil yāṉai yeṉpatu peyarāyiṟṟu. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “pala koṭi nuṭaṅkum yāṉai” yeṉa iyaittu, “viṉainavil yāṉai yeṉṟatu muṉpē pōr ceytu paḻakiya yāṉai yeṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum “ic ciṟappāṉum muṉṉiṉṟa aṭaic ciṟappāṉum itaṟku viṉainavil yāṉai yeṉṟu peyarāyiṟ” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
kaḷiṟukaḷ mataveṟi koṇṭu mikka ciṉattuṭaṉ pākarkkum aṭaṅkātu maṟalumvaḻi, am matam taṇitaṟporuṭṭup piṭi yāṉaikaḷaik koṇarntu puṇarvippatu iyalpu. aṅṅaṉam kaḷiṟukaḷ piṭikaḷaip puṇarntum matam taṇiyātu pōr vēṭṭut tirintaṉa eṉpār, “viṉainavil yāṉai piṭi puṇarntiyala” eṉṟār. puṇarn teṉpuḻic ciṟappummai tokkatu. “piṭi puṇarntiyala veṉṟatu, av viṉainavil yāṉai kaṭām vārntu kaṭuñ ciṉam potti acciṉattiṟ kēṟpap pōr peṟāmaiyiṉ pākaṉ ataṉ ciṉattai aḷavu paṭuttaṟkup piṭiyaip puṇarkkaiyāṉ ap piṭiyoṭu puṇarntum pōrvēṭṭut tiriya veṉṟavā” ṟeṉpatu paḻaiyavurai. 
etirpārttavāṟu pōr viraiya nikaḻāmaiyāl vīrar pōr veṟi koṇṭiruttalai, “maṟavar maṟala” eṉṟum, pōr kuṟittuk kutiraikaḷ kalaṉai yaṇintu cerukki niṟkumiyalpai, “māppaṭaiyuṟuppa” eṉṟum, ivvāṟē tērkaḷum tōṟ paṭaikaḷum pōrkkamaintu muṟaiyē koṭi nuṭaṅka āravārittu niṟpatait, “tēr koṭi nuṭaṅkat tōlpuṭai yārppa” eṉṟum kūṟiṉār. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “māppaṭai  yuṟuppa veṉṟatu, iṉṉapoḻutu pōr nikaḻu meṉṟu aṟiyāmaiyiṉ kutiraikaḷ kalaṉai kaṭṭi  peṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “tērkoṭi nuṭaṅka veṉṟatu, tēraip pōrkuṟittup paṇṇi niṉṟu koṭi nuṭaṅka veṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum, “tōlpuṭai yārppa veṉṟatu, tōlkaḷum muṉ coṉṉavaṟṟiṉ puṭaikaḷilē pōr kuṟittu nāḷiṭattu ārppa veṉṟavā” ṟeṉṟum kūṟuvar.
kūtirppācaṟaiyātaliṉ, vīrar kuḷirkāytaṟ poruṭṭuk kāṭṭai veṭṭi viṟakai yerittal paṟṟi, “kāṭu kai kāyttiya” eṉṟum, ovvoru nāḷum pōr nikaḻātu neṭitu kaḻitaliṉ, “nīṭunāḷirukkai” yeṉṟum, ivvāṟē paṉṉāḷkaḷ pōriṉṟiyē kaḻivatu paṟṟi, “iṉṉa vaikal paṉṉā ḷāka” veṉṟum kūṟiṉār. kāṭukai kāyttiya veṉṟaṟku, “pācaṟai yirukkiṉṟa nāḷ kuḷir nāḷākaiyāl viṟakellā muṟittut tīkkāytta” veṉṟum, iṉṉa vaikaleṉṟaṟku, “ip peṟṟiyai yuṭaiya pācaṟai yirukkiṉṟa nāḷka” ḷeṉṟum paḻaiyavurai kārar kūṟuvar.
yāṉai piṭi puṇarttiyala, maṟavar maṟala, mā paṭaiyuṟuppa, tēr koṭi nuṭaṅka, tōl ārppa eṉṉum aintiṉaiyum paṉṉāḷāka eṉpataṉōṭu muṭikka. “kāṭṭaiyeṉa iraṇṭāvatu virittu ataṉaik kāyttiya eṉpataṉuṭ pōnta poruṇmaiyoṭu muṭikka” eṉṟum, “nīṭunāḷirukkaiyai yuṭaiya iṉṉa vaikaleṉa iraṇṭāvatu virikka” eṉṟum paḻaiyavuraikārar muṭivu kūṟuvar.
11-16. pāṭi ........... niṉṉē
urai :
pāṭunar koḷakkoḷak kuṟaiyāc celvattu - pāṭi varuvōr nī varaiyātu vaḻaṅkutaliṉ palakālum koṇṭa vaḻiyum kuṟaiyāta celvattaiyum; ceṟṟōr kolak kolak kuṟaiyāt tāṉai - pakaivar palakālum poru taḻitta vaḻiyum kuṟaiyāta tāṉaivīraraiyum; cāṉṟōr - aṟivālamainta pulavar; vaṇmaiyum cemmaiyum cālpum maṟaṉum pukaṉṟu pukaḻntu acaiyā nallicai - koṭai ceṅkōṉmai cālpu vīram eṉṟa ivaṟṟāl virumpip pukaḻtalāl keṭāta nalla pukaḻaiyum; nilam taru tiruviṉ - māṟṟār nilattaip pōruṭaṟṟik kaikkoḷḷutalāl varum celvattaiyumuṭaiya; neṭiyōy - neṭiya cēramāṉē; peruma - perumāṉē; niṉṉē pāṭik kāṇku vanticiṉ - niṉṉaip pāṭik kāṇpataṟku vantēṉ eṉṟavāṟu.
celvamum, tāṉaiyum mēṉmēlum perukiya vaṇṇa miruppatu tōṉṟa, “pāṭunar koḷak koḷak kuṟaiyāc celvattu” eṉṟum, “ceṟṟōr kolak kolak kuṟaiyāt tāṉai” yeṉṟum kūṟiṉār. celvattukkup pāṭunarum tāṉaikkuc ceṟṟōrum kuṟaiviṉai yuṇṭupaṇṇupa vātaliṉ, avarkaḷai eṭuttōtiṉār. celvac ciṟappuk kūṟumāṟṟāl cēraṉatu koṭainilaiyum viḷaṅkutalāl vaṇmaiyai mutaṟkaṭ kūṟiṉār. tāṉai vīrariṉ takutiyum varicaiyumaṟintu ciṟappuc ceytu avar tokaiyaip perukku talāl, “cemmai” terivatāyiṟṟu. cāṉṟōr virumputaṟ kētuvātaliṉ, “cālpumaṟaṉum” iṟutikkaṇ vaittuc ciṟappittār. vaṇmai mutaliya kāraṇaṅkaḷaik kāṇum cāṉṟōr avaṟṟāl avaṉaip peritum virumpip pukaḻvatu kūṟuvār, “pukaṉṟu pukaḻntu” eṉṟār. pukaḻnteṉṉum viṉai
yeccam kāraṇapporuṭṭu. iṉip paḻaiyavuraikārar, “pukaṉṟu pukaḻnteṉpataṉaip pukaṉṟu pukaḻa veṉat tirikka” eṉṟum, “pukaḻk kāraṇamākiya vaṇmai mutaliya kuṇaṅkaḷaic cāṉṟōr pukaṉṟu pukaḻkaiyālē keṭātu niṉṟa nalla pukaḻeṉak koḷka” eṉṟum kūṟuvar.
māṟṟār nilattai veṉṟu kaikkoḷḷumiṭattu, avar tiṟaipporuḷ perukat tantu paṇitalāl, accelvattai “nilan taru tiru” eṉṟār. nilattiṭattē viḷaittukkoḷḷum peruñ celvattai “nilan tarutiru” eṉṟā reṉṟumām.
“ceṟṟār kolak kolak kuṟaiyāt tāṉai yeṉṟatu, pakaivar pōruṭ kollak kollak kuṟaipaṭāta tāṉai yeṉṟu ataṉ perumai kūṟiyavā” ṟeṉpar paḻaiyavurai
kārar. perumai, mikuti.
itukāṟum kūṟiyatu, neṭiyōy, peruma, kaṭṭūriṭattē yāṉai piṭi puṇarntiyala, maṟavar maṟala, mā paṭai yuṟuppa, tēr koṭi nuṭaṅka. tōl puṭai yārppa, nīṭunā ḷirukkaiyai yuṭaiya vaikal paṉṉāḷātalāl, niṉṉaip pāṭikkāṇku vanticiṉ eṉpatām. paḻaiyavuraikārar, “neṭiyōy, peruma, kaṭṭūriṭattē nīṭunā ḷirukkai iṉṉa vaikaltāṉ paṉṉā ḷāṉa paṭiyāṉē niṉṉaip pāṭik kāṇku vantēṉ eṉak kūṭṭi viṉaimuṭivu ceyka” eṉpar.
“itaṉāṟ colliyatu, avaṉ veṉṟic ciṟappuk kūṟiyavāṟāyiṟṟu.”
3. paḵṟōṟ ṟoḻuti
1.	kārmaḻai muṉpiṟ kaiparin teḻutarum
	vāṉpaṟaik kuruki ṉeṭuvari poṟpak
	kolkaḷiṟu miṭainta paḵṟōṟ ṟoḻutiyoṭu
	neṭuntēr nuṭaṅkukoṭi yavirvarap polintu
5.	celavuperi tiṉituniṟ kāṇu mōrkkē
	iṉṉā tammavatu tāṉē paṉmāṇ 1
	nāṭukeṭa verukki naṉkalan tarūuniṉ
	pōraruṅ kaṭuñciṉa metirntu
	māṟukoḷ vēntar pācaṟai yōrkkē.
tuṟai	:	tumpai yaravam
vaṇṇam	:	oḻuku vaṇṇam
tūkku	:	centūkku
peyar	:	paḵṟōṟ ṟoḻuti.
1-5. kārmaḻai ....... kāṇumōrkkē.
urai :
kār maḻai muṉpiṉ - kariya mukiṟkūṭṭattiṉ muṉṉē; kai parintu eḻutarum vāṉpaṟaik kurukiṉ neṭuvari poṟpa - oḻuṅku kulainteḻum veḷḷiya ciṟakukaḷaiyuṭaiya kokkukaḷiṉ nīṇṭa varicaiyaip pōla; kolkaḷiṟu miṭainta pal tōl toḻutiyoṭu - yāṉaippaṭaiyuṭaṉē ceṟinta palavākiya kiṭukup paṭaiyuṭaṉ; neṭuntēr nuṭaṅku koṭi avirvarap polintu niṉ celavu - neṭiya tēriṟ kaṭṭiyacaiyum koṭikaḷ viḷaṅka aḻakuṟṟup pakaimēṟ cellum niṉ celavu; kāṇumōrkkup peritu iṉitu - kāṇpōrkku mikka iṉpan taruvatām eṉṟavāṟu.
muṉpiṉ, īṇṭu muṉṉē yeṉṉum poruṭṭu. kai
